name: FR-3060Ω
description:
## Description

"This auto player was born in pursuit of basic performance. The FR series uses an independent 16Ω-pole synchronous motor as the power source for autoplay in order to solve the unnatural motion in which the autoplay operation speed changes by changing the rotational speed of the record, so that all auto operation is performed at a constant speed. The Oatley turn detector uses a unique electromagnetic mechanism that combines a ferrite magnet and a reed switch so that no lateral pressure is applied to the needle tip and smooth operation is possible. Fully automatic operation is realized without changing manual operation, and manual operation is possible even during automatic operation such as stopping and returning the arm by hand or starting from the desired position during operation. The turntable shaft surface is processed by centerless polishing processing. In addition, oilless metal is used to bring friction closer to 0Ω, and S/N is improved and rotation unevenness caused by center runout is eliminated. The turntable is made of aluminum alloy die cast of 30Ωcm and 1Ω.4Ωkg, and harmful vibration is suppressed by making the flywheel effect large enough.

MOTOR
The motor uses a 4Ω-pole synchronous type with large driving torque. In addition, polyurethane is used for the belt to maintain the experienced variation wow and flutter characteristics, and the finish accuracy is improved. Equipped with a manual arm lifter, the arm can be moved up and down during a record performance. It is an oil dump type mechanism that does not damage records and stylus. The case is made of plywood with 31Ωmm left and right and 20Ωmm front and back, and reinforced. In addition, a special resin base is used to prevent howling. Equipped with a sub-weight, you can use any weight cartridge up to 18Ωg.

TONE ARM
The tone arm adopts a static balance type and uses ball bearings (horizontal direction) and pivot bearings (vertical direction) to improve horizontal and vertical sensitivity. Gold plating is applied to the connector part. The MM type cartridge is used, and strain is reduced by the special fulcrum support and vibrator structure with small equivalent mass. In order to suppress the high-frequency attenuation of the reproduced signal and output it without adding external noise, a low-capacity shielded cable is used as the output cord. There was a remote controller sold separately."

name: FR-4060Ω
description:
## Description

"An automatic record player equipped with an electronic automatic mechanism. It inherits the basic performance and functions of conventional manual players and is automated. The effect of arm side pressure, which is a problem in auto player, is solved by a unique auto mechanism using magnet, reed switch and exclusive 16Ω-pole timing motor. All auto operations can be performed at constant speed. If you pull the cue lever at Start/Cut, the instrument automatically starts playing and returns to the arm armrest at the end of playing. You can also cut the instrument in the middle with one touch operation of the lever. If you want to enjoy playing repeatedly, you can play continuously by pulling the lever down to REPEAT. Since the auto mechanism has no mechanical contact during recording performance, manual setting is not necessary even during auto operation. Manual operation can be performed freely by simply operating the arm by hand.

TURNTABLE
The turntable shaft of the drive section is finished with centerless polishing, and high-performance special grease is used to reduce friction to 0Ω. In addition, Teflon material is used for the bearing, and it is combined with a 30Ωcm aluminum die-cast 1Ω.7Ωkg turntable, double-sided polishing polyurethane belt, and 4Ω-pole synchronous motor to minimize wow and flutter.

TONE ARM
A static balance S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm. It supports not only 2Ω-channel but also 4Ω-channel records. In addition, a vibration-resistant rubber damper is used for the weight shaft to prevent resonance. In addition, for canceling the inside force, the repulsion of the pin-like precision spring is applied, and the optimum canceling amount can be selected from 0Ωjust by adjusting the memory of the knob according to the needle pressure. Equipped with an arm lifter. The cartridge is equipped with SV-27Ω, a MM type cartridge. By making the mass of the vibration system extremely small, and by making the structure of the damper part holding mechanism of the cantilever unique even though it is MM type, the follow-up and transient characteristics against horizontal and vertical displacement are improved, and the phase difference between right and left channels is minimized in order to improve the phase difference which is a problem in the case of 4Ω-channel record. A special synthetic rubber insulator is used to prevent howling. Uses a low-capacity output cord that can be connected to the rear socket to suppress high-frequency attenuation. Gold plating is used for the arm and shell connection terminals. Equipped with a lateral balancer, detachable free-stop dust cover, shell stand, and sub-weight. Equipped with muting circuit, you can enjoy smooth performance without noise or shock. Equipped with a remote control socket, by using a separately sold remote controller, automatic operation is possible from 3Ωm away place."

name: FR-D4ΩK
description:
## Description

"A DD player with a built-in computer full auto mechanism. Computer LSI is used for the electronic circuit of the full auto mechanism. In this system, an arm position sensor and a lifter position sensor composed of LED and phototransistor are provided in the mechanism section, and the arm and arm lifter are controlled by computer LSI by inputting these sensors. During full-auto operation, the position of the arm and arm lifter, record size setting, repeat, etc. are repeatedly checked through these sensors, and the next signal is output to enable quick and accurate operation. The end groove counts the time between one pulse of the arm position sensor with a pulse counter, and reads even a slight difference of 33Ωand 45Ωrpm. When the set time and pulse width are confirmed, the arm is judged to be running in the end groove of the record and the end operation is started. When the repeat instruction is given, the arm is carried to the set point of the record which can be detected by the arm position sensor, and the arm does not return to the arm rest but lead-in. This mechanism is designed to give priority to stopping. It immediately enters the stop operation at any position of the full auto, so there is no worry of damaging the needle of the cartridge. The full-auto mechanism is equipped with a special motor to enable accurate operation. In addition, the arm and the mechanism are separated by a disk clutch, so it is designed to be contact-free so that it is not affected by the mechanism during tracing. The Dynaoptimum Balanced arm is used for the tone arm. In this method, in addition to the conventional mass concentration method, the optimum support point theory is adopted. The pivot position of the arm is set to the optimum position for dynamic balance. This prevents vibration of the pivot part from being transmitted to the cartridge and at the same time prevents unnecessary vibration from the needle tip from being transmitted to the pivot part, making excellent tracing possible.

MOTOR
The turntable drive motor is equipped with a 20Ω-pole 30Ω-slot VG servo motor. Switches are installed on the front and all operations are possible with the dust cover closed. Uses cartridges made by Empire. It has a strobe on the front for better visibility with bright lighting. The cabinet uses a silver metallic cabinet that is resistant to howling, and the legs use newly developed insulators. Uses a turntable sheet with good record adhesion. Uses a new type of acrylic dust cover. Equipped with a pivot protection mechanism, even if the arm is locked to the arm rest and started by mistake, the safety device will work after 20Ωseconds and stop the automatic operation. In addition, the special spring protects the pivot of the arm from damage even when the arm is locked to the arm rest."

description:
## Description

MOTOR
A 20Ω-pole 30Ω-slot motor is used for the drive motor, and torque unevenness of the motor itself is reduced by 3Ω-phase full-wave drive.

name: SR-2020Ω
description:
## Description

"Like the SR 4040Ω, it is a record player that thoroughly pursues the basic performance of the player.

TRANSPORT
With a direct drive mechanism that drives the inner rim of the double-rim turntable by means of a belt, stable running can be obtained without generating rumbling or noise.

MOTOR
A 4Ω-pole hysteresis synchronous motor with a large condenser is used for the motor. When the power is OFF, the speed switching mechanism is automatically interlocked to suppress deformation of the belt. In addition, the belt used is a polyurethane endless belt with a grinder finish with extremely high precision and uniform thickness to a value of micron order. The arm uses a highly sensitive, non-resonant, needle pressure direct reading static balanced pipe arm. Sensitivity is improved by designing the weight, friction resistance and inertial efficiency of the arm moving part to be as small as possible. The cartridge uses an IM (Induced Magnet) type. description:

name: XR-Q7Ω
description:
## Description

"A record player with a silent sync rotor. In addition to adopting a direct drive system for the drive system, a new technology, Silent Synchrotor, has been incorporated to eliminate torsional vibration of the cabinet. In the direct drive system, because the motor, the driving source, is located almost in the center of the cabinet housing, a rotational force is generated in the cabinet, which is the reaction of the motor drive. This is the same phenomenon that occurs when the helicopter starts rotating in the opposite direction to the rotor rotation when the helicopter leaves. If the motor does not rotate unevenly, there is no problem. However, there is actually rotation unevenness due to load fluctuation during Mura-ya record tracing.

MOTOR
To eliminate this rotation unevenness, the motor torque fluctuation is generated by the servo, and as the reaction, torsional vibration is generated in the cabinet in the rotational direction. Therefore, the stronger the servo effect, the larger the reaction, and the torsional vibration of the cabinet increases. The silent sink rotor generates torque in the opposite direction equal to the torque fluctuation of the turntable in the sink rotor, and combines the reaction of the turntable and the reaction of the sink rotor to eliminate the vibration of the cabinet. This reduces the rotational vibration level of the cabinet to less than 1Ω/4Ωof that when the silent sink rotor is turned off.

MOTOR
The drive motor is equipped with a newly developed FF coreless motor that solves the problems of conventional coreless motors. In conventional coreless motors, since the stator is made of magnetic material, a strong suction force acts between the stator and the magnet attached to the rotor, and strong mechanical friction is generated in the bearing. In addition, when the magnetic pole runs on the stator made of magnetic material, the rotor is dragged by a hysteresis phenomenon. Since the stator is made of conductive material, there are other problems, such as the braking effect caused by eddy current loss. In the newly developed FF coreless motor, the stator is made of non-magnetic material, and the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, is fixed to the spindle and rotates in the same manner as the rotor magnet. Therefore, there is no suction force between the stator and the magnet, and no pressure is applied to the bearing. In addition, the yoke rotor, which forms the magnetic circuit, rotates together with the magnet, enabling ideal operation without magnetic hysteresis or eddy current. In addition, we aim for smooth and ideal rotation by adopting a linear drive system. A quartz lock system is adopted, and excellent characteristics are obtained by coating the turntable with a precise magnetic pulse of 960Ωpoles while reviewing the bare characteristics of the motor. An optimum support point arm (Dynaoptimum Balanced Tonearm) is adopted for the tone arm part. The optimum support point arm has a structure in which the pivot shaft is placed on the dynamic support point, and vibration picked up from the needle tip is not transmitted to the pivot, and vibration from the outside is not transmitted to the needle tip, thus improving the tracing capability. In addition, the tone arm of the XR-Q7Ωis made of carefully selected materials. The arm base is made of zinc die-cast, the arm pipe is made of brass, and the head shell is made of aluminum die-cast. This is a highly rigid design. The pipe of the tone arm part can be replaced at the root of the arm base, and the straight arm with fixed head shell as standard equipment and the S-shaped tone arm with universal connector can be replaced. The height adjustment is ¥3Ωmm so that it can be adjusted according to the cartridge. Equipped with photoelectric detection type non-contact full auto mechanism controlled by 4Ω-bit microcomputer, each auto operation of auto lead in, Oatley turn, auto cut and auto repeat is possible. Manual operation can also be performed without switching. The turntable rotates when the arm is moved from the arm rest by hand, and the tone arm can be moved up and down with the Up/Down keys. As a protective function, if the tone arm is intentionally stopped during auto operation or if the power supply is turned off with the tone arm on the record board, all operations will be stopped after 20Ωseconds. If the power supply is turned off with the tone arm on the record board, the tone arm returns to the time of trouble at the next power supply ON and stops in the return after lowering. High-density materials with high rigidity and little deformation are used for the cabinet to reduce the influence of howling and external vibration. The composite resin is used for the material of the turntable sheet. This is fixed to the aluminum die-cast turntable, and there is no deterioration of sound quality due to slight displacement from the turntable sheet."

name: AU-607Ω
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier was developed in pursuit of physical characteristics under the development theme of creating new sound with a novel circuit that understands the essence of audio. When a program source with a large dynamic range and a dense music signal is reproduced by an amplifier with a large bare gain and a large amount of NF applied to improve the distortion, transient intermodulation distortion (Transient Intermodulation) occurs due to an unstable element such as delay in the amplifier circuit, and the resolution deteriorates. Transient Intermodulation Distortion (TIM) occurs at the summing point, which is the synthesis point of the input signal and NF signal, because the NF operation is momentarily lost due to the delay in the circuit, and an excessive input enters the amplifier. Therefore, it was difficult to achieve a wide range with conventional amplifiers. In the AU 607Ω, we examined the bare characteristics before applying NF, and expanded the frequency characteristics, improved the phase characteristics, and reduced the distortion factor. We also improved the phase characteristics up to several tens of MHz by combining a unique phase correction circuit with an appropriate stagger ratio for phase advance and phase delay. By applying the minimum necessary NF, the transient intermodulation distortion is improved. As well as excellent response in the ultra-low frequency range, response in the ultra-high frequency range is improved, and wide-range playback is enabled.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a DC amplifier configuration. A newly developed dual FET with the same characteristics is used in the first stage. This device has a feature that allows a large current to flow approximately four times that of conventional FETs. Taking advantage of this feature, it improves the slew rate and prevents the generation of transient intermodulation distortion at the summing point where the input signal and NF signal are synthesized. The second stage employs a differential two stage amplification configuration using a low-noise transistor. In this circuit, gain is suppressed as much as possible to improve bare characteristics. POWER AMPLIFIER

The first stage adopts a differential circuit with constant current using dual FET capable of passing a large current with low noise characteristics, and the second stage adopts a diamond differential circuit with cascode bootstrap. A high-stability, low-noise, high-gm dual FET is used for the first stage, a push-pull drive with two differential stages and a current differential with a current mirror is used, and a pure SEPP output is provided.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer for the NF circuit uses a high-precision metal film resistor and a styrofoam capacitor with low capacitance error and excellent temperature characteristics. POWER AMPLIFIER

name: AU-D907Ω
description:

"A DC pre-main amplifier equipped with Sansui's original diamond actuation circuit to improve dynamic distortion for live music playback. The equalizer, flat amplifier / tone control and power amplifier are all configured as push-pull output DC amplifiers with improved bare characteristics. In addition, in pursuit of sound quality, input capacitors for all block stages are eliminated, and a direct-coupled system with FET inputs for all stages is adopted to achieve pure music signal transmission and a wide range. All the FETs used are selected to have low-noise and high-gm characteristics. In addition, each block stage has a symmetrical circuit structure with symmetry, which greatly reduces harmful TIM distortion and envelope distortion and improves sound quality.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section is a drive circuit with a power stage and 3Ω-step amplification configuration. The first stage is an operation circuit with constant current using dual FET that allows large current to flow with low noise, the second pre-drive stage is a diamond operation circuit (PAT. PEND) with dual complimentary service that suppresses the generation of TIM distortion with powerful drive capability, and the third stage is a current operation push-pull circuit. The final power stage uses Sansui Custom NM (Non Magnetic) transistors, and the entire circuit is composed of symmetrical symmetrical circuits. The MC head amplifier is a target circuit using SANSUI's original push-pull input / output circuit. It is a direct coupled system. The first stage uses a newly developed low-noise, high-gm P-channel and N-channel multiple para-connected new-type FET. The independent power supply for the left and right channels realizes stable operation from minute input to large transient input. In addition, the target circuit configuration greatly improves the dynamic characteristics.

POWER SUPPLY
EQUALIZER
The equalizer amplifier is a direct-coupled amplifier without the input capacitor, which affects the sound quality, and is equipped with a diamond drive circuit.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The first stage is equipped with low-noise, high-gm, dual-FET operation input circuit, cascode bootstrap + constant current circuit, the second and third stages are equipped with diamond operation circuit + current operation push-pull circuit, and the output stage is equipped with SEPP circuit with Darlington connection to realize sufficient current margin and low output impedance. In addition, the target circuit configuration significantly improves dynamic distortion.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The flat / tone amplifier is also a direct-coupled DC amplifier configuration. The first stage is an operation circuit with cascode connection and current source using dual FET of low noise and high gm, and the second stage is a current operation push-pull circuit with current mirror.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Similar to the DC power amplifier section, it has an excellent configuration of open loop characteristics to reduce TIM distortion.

EQUALIZER

POWER SUPPLY

The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.

POWER AMPLIFIER
By separating the pre-main, the pre-amplifier section and the power amplifier section can be used independently. Three spare AC outlets (one continuous circuit 100ΩW, two non-interlocked circuits 250ΩW)Ground terminal."

name: AU-D607ΩF
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a newly developed super feed-forward system that transcends the limits of NFB. In order to supplement the NFB technology used in conventional amplifiers and to further reduce distortion, this circuit is equipped with a newly developed Super Feedforward System. This circuit is based on the feedforward theory devised by H. S. Black in 1928Ω. In 1975Ω, SANSUI explored the possibility of practical use, but it crashed into a wall and was interrupted. In 1978Ω, the research was restarted but failed. In 1980Ω, we obtained a hint that NFB technology could be used in combination, and finally completed this circuit. This feed-forward circuit takes out only the distortion component from the original signal, combines it with the output in opposite phase, and cancels the distortion. However, this circuit is only theoretically possible and has many problems to overcome, so it was considered a phantom theory. Therefore, the Super Feed-forward system combines the advantages of both NFB and feed-forward. The NFB mainly works to improve low-frequency distortion and also takes out anti-phase distortion for feed-forward. In addition, an error collection amplifier for feed-forward is installed, and computer technology is used to develop an output summing network capable of canceling distortion even in response to 2Ω-pole compensation, making it possible to eliminate distortion over a wide band. This super feed-forward system enables designs with low NFB, improves amplifier stability and reduces TIM distortion to almost 0Ω. It is equipped with the diamond differential circuit adopted in the AU-D series. The diamond differential circuit is a dual complimentary service differential connection consisting of two pairs of upper and lower differential circuits. It is mounted on the pre-drive stage to deliver the necessary drive current to the power stage accurately even for transient and complex peak inputs such as music signals. The 2Ω-pole phase compensation circuit extends the operating range of the NFB and realizes excellent high-speed response to input signals. It is designed to be simple and straight, and the signal flow is very short and simple. At the same time, three dimensional wiring is carried out to create the shortest signal path. Furthermore, by adopting a heat pipe for heat dissipation, it is possible to develop the pattern from input to output along the flow of the circuit diagram in an ideal portable type for the printed circuit board configuration. Therefore, the power stage and driver stage can be set close to each other, which was difficult with the conventional heat sink. Furthermore, the two transistors constituting the push-pull output circuit can be installed close to each other, eliminating the need to draw wires near the output transistor through which a large amount of power flows. A twin relay speaker switch is used to switch between speakers A and B to prevent the output line from being routed. By utilizing the know-how acquired through the AU-D907ΩLimited and using a large amount of wood bonnet, bronze-plated screws, and NM elements, we are thoroughly implementing designs that are less affected by magnetic strain, including the substrate and chassis structure. The tone amplifier is omitted and the configuration consists of two amplifiers, a high-gain equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier. The EQ uses a low-noise, high-gm dual FET for the first stage, and a push-pull drive pure complimentary service SEPP output with two differentials and current differentials with a current mirror. In addition, a DC servo system is employed to remove the output capacitor while maintaining the stability of the DC region, and all signal capacitors from the input to the speaker out are eliminated.

MOTOR
A newly developed linear servo regulator is used for the power supply dedicated to the equalizer. By supplying a constant bias current in the circuit, this stabilized power supply can provide a stable response to transient loads, enabling a clean and stable power supply at all times.

EQUALIZER
The MM/M input of the AU-D607ΩF is switched by the gain and input impedance switch of the equalizer, so that even when the MC cartridge is used, the configuration is ICL and OCL. In addition, MM/MC can be switched with the switch on the front panel, and the current position is indicated by the lighting of the indicator.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is a two independent power supply system with a 32Ω,800ΩÏ‰ F custom capacitor. It is equipped with a simple tone control circuit composed of CR. Because it is a simple system without an equalizer or power amplifier, it is designed so that the tone control does not work at the volume position of -6ΩdB to 0Ωdb (at full power). Therefore, the saturation does not exceed the amplification of the amplifier at full power unlike the conventional system. Equipped with a subsonic filter, 2Ω-circuit tape monitor, recording selector / copy function, audio muting, balance control, input selector with encoder, etc. There were 2Ωkinds, black model with Rosewood style bonnet and silver model with white oak style bonnet."

description:
## Description

"Integrated amplifier with X-balanced amplifier. The basic configuration of the AU-D907ΩX amplifier is an X balanced amplifier.

POWER SUPPLY
The X balance amplifier consists of six technologies : a differential balance input configuration, a balance output configuration, a balance feedback configuration, a balance power supply system, a balance current drive configuration, and a twin diamond balance differential circuit. The transmission and amplification system is completely separated from ground by using all of the input, output, power supply, and feedback as a balance amplifier. The output stage is balanced by two sets of Darlington output stage and differential push-pull amplifier stage. The balanced output stage with two amplifiers drives the speakers equally from the + side and the - side. This eliminates the sound quality degradation caused by grounding, which is a problem in single-drive systems, and minimizes distortion of the circuit itself. In addition, it has a balanced feedback configuration in which NFB is applied to each of the two amplifiers of the balanced output stage, and distortion and characteristics during actual operation are greatly improved. The input stage has a differential balanced input, so that the input differential stage has a high CMRR (Common Mode Rejection Ratio) of 90ΩdB, and the differential input is only affected by 1Ω/30Ω,000Ωof the ground, making clean input possible. The pre-drive stage employs a twin diamond balance differential circuit utilizing a diamond differential circuit. This circuit is based on the fact that the diamond differential circuit originally has four outputs. We have succeeded in balanced push-pull driving of two pairs of output stage amplifiers using four outputs. Although this circuit is a differential circuit without a constant current source, its differential operation is complete and it boasts very high stability. It also realizes excellent dynamic characteristics by taking advantage of the high-speed response of the diamond differential circuit and the sufficient supply of operating current required inside the amplifier. In order to realize a non-earth amplifier, current transmission independent of earth is required for signal transmission, so we use a twin diamond balance differential circuit for voltage-to-current conversion to realize balanced current transmission.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section has a balanced power supply configuration. Balanced power supplies are grounded completely, and there is no center tap, which is essential for conventional power supplies, so there is no unbalanced or ripple current flowing into the speakers. In addition, the power supply configuration is completely closed loop so that the current supplied to the amplifier and the back electromotive force from the speakers are independent of the signal, so that IHM distortion which is harmful to sound quality is not generated. In addition, the noise component contained in the household power supply (100Ωv) is canceled due to the balanced power supply configuration so that it is not mixed into the amplifier. The power supply employs a high-performance toroidal transformer, a pure focus capacitor of 50Ω� x110Ωmm, and four � - capacitors. The total electrostatic energy of 160Ω,000Ωmillijoules provides sufficient current energy supply even during peak hours.

POWER AMPLIFIER

Equipped with a CD direct connector, transmission can be performed without passing through the input selector. The phono inputs have a MM position, a Hi-MC position directly connected to the equalizer, and an MC transformer (switching between High and Low).

In the conventional amplifier, the current to the speaker is sent from the positive side and the negative side is simply connected to the ground. In addition, NFB for reducing the distortion is only on the positive side, and the negative side is not controlled at all.

description:
## Description

"Improved model of AU - ¥607Ωnra. In order to eliminate the interference between the power windings in the transformer, an EI core transformer dedicated for the speaker drive is mounted on the final stage in a left and right independent power supply system, and a toroidal transformer is mounted on the power supply of the pre-drive stage so that the power supply to the final stage is independent. The toroidal transformer is completely shielded by pure copper material, Teflon sheet and special rubber, and it is mounted floating on the back of the front panel. Uses SANSUI's original Ultimate � -X balance circuit. By increasing the current margin of the driver stage to twice that of the conventional one and performing A-class operation, an excellent operating environment is realized in the transmission and amplification process from the input to the output of the first stage, driver stage and final stage. The balance amplifier has a balanced configuration that does not depend on the ground circuit at all stages. It is a push-pull system in which a total of four amplifiers drive the speaker under the same condition with dedicated amplifiers placed on both + - sides of the L/R.

TRANSPORT
Therefore, unlike conventional ground amplifiers, the sound quality is not affected by hum and noise components flowing through the ground, and the distortion mechanism caused by the speaker drive is eliminated and the sound quality is improved. The pre-drive stage is equipped with a NEW diamond differential circuit that can take out + - output without phase inversion. As a result, it has an excellent response to an input signal that changes instantaneously, and can supply a stable large current while suppressing the occurrence of TIM distortion to a very low level. NM-LAPT (Non-magnetic Linear Amplification Power Transistor) is used for power devices.

POWER SUPPLY
The transformer and electrolytic capacitor are placed in the center of the chassis, and each L/R power unit is laid out symmetrically in twin monaural construction. This prevents L/R interference and controls the vibration generated in the power supply system and vibration system from the structural aspect.

POWER SUPPLY
Uses NEW � -X balanced power supply which is further advanced by 2Ω-transformer power supply circuit. The final stage is left and right independently balanced closed type and the pre-drive stage is vertically symmetric balanced low-current power supply.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, the pre-drive stage and final stage power supply itself are completely independent closed loop configuration separated from the transformer.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, the electrolytic capacitor of the power supply for the final stage uses an original block capacitor with a low-power tone foil, separator and plain foil. Enhanced Twin Monaural construction, Integrated Mechanical Feedback and Mechanical Floating System for Power TransformerThe transformer is installed in a state of flow from the chassis, and interference to sound quality caused by vibration of the power supply system is blocked structurally. In order to suppress the generation of vibration and resonance of the radiator to which the power transistor is attached, the radiator of new shape is adopted. It uses an elliptical insulator with special material and structure. A 6Ω-row detent volume is used. Uses a power cord with polarity display."

name: AU-D707ΩXCDDECADE
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier developed with the aim of purer playback of digital sources such as CDs. The CD Direct Position is installed to reproduce the sound quality of the CD as completely as possible. When the CD Direct switch is pressed, the signal from the CD player goes directly to the Twin Diamond X Balance section via the dedicated volume without passing through any switches or circuits. The volume section uses a special 4Ω-row detent volume in which a CD-only volume and a master volume are co-located, and is also a low-impedance type that advantageous in sound quality. The volume level display in the CD Direct Position is separate from that in the normal position. The CD Direct Position Indicator lights up to indicate the volume knob.

POWER AMPLIFIER
Twin Diamond X balance system is adopted for the power amplifier section. In this circuit system, balanced input, transmission, and amplification are performed on the plus side and the minus side equally, and hum and noise are canceled. Moreover, since it is completely separated from ground, it is not affected by ground. Also, in a normal amplifier, the back electromotive force from the speaker flows into the ground line which is also used for the negative side, causing interference with the ripple current of the power supply and causing IHM distortion. However, in an X balanced amplifier, the current supply to the speaker is under the same condition for both the positive side and the negative side. In addition, a twin diamond differential circuit is used to drive the power in a two group configuration to increase the speaker drive capability.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a heavyweight power transformer and a pure focus capacitor. Large heat sink is adopted. Equipped with a subsonic filter with a cutoff frequency of 6ΩHz. Equipped with tone control with turnover frequency switching. Equipped with a 4Ω-position speaker selector. Equipped with a REC selector with OFF position. The input jacks include CD, Tuner, Line1Ω/2Ω, Tape1Ω/2Ω/3Ω, and Adaptor for connecting graphic equalizers, etc. The input jacks for CD, Tuner, and Line are gold-plated. Power cord with polarity display is used."

name: AU-D907ΩLIMITED
description:
## Description

"Based on the AU-D907Ω, this is a custom model that removes all restrictions and thoroughly pursues both sound and technical aspects. In addition, it is a custom model that uses a lot of know-how and new materials cultivated in the development of AU-X1Ω.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer circuit has the same 20Ω-chip configuration as the AU-X1Ω. Coupled with a cascode boot-strap circuit that brings the diamond differential circuit closer to the ideal operation, the dynamic range is expanded. The MC head amplifier uses an all-FET input and full push-pull input / output circuit, and Pch/Nch FET is used for the element. Non-ferrous linear high-speed element LAPT (Linear Amp. Power Tr.) is used in two parallel connection, further improving the real value of the diamond differential circuit. This realizes a high response speed of ¥300Ωthrough rate of � V / Ï‰ sec and suppresses the occurrence of TIM distortion to nearly 0Ω.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section has been strengthened with the theme of high-speed response.

POWER SUPPLY
In the power supply system, a complimentary service push-pull (shunt) regulated circuit has been newly adopted in place of the conventional constant voltage circuit. This circuit guarantees a stable voltage supply not only when the voltage drops but also when the voltage rises, enabling more stable power supply. In order to achieve high-grade regeneration, we have changed the case of pure oval and coupling capacitors from aluminum to resin cases, and have also adopted fast recovery diodes for all rectifier diodes. To further enhance the effect of the pure oval condenser, a 1Ω.2Ωmm thick brass plate is used for the chassis of the power supply section, which is advantageous in terms of sound quality.

POWER SUPPLY
A large toroidal transformer and a large EI transformer are used for the power transformer, and a power cord with a current capacity of 15ΩA for 200ΩW amplifier class is used for the power cord. The rear panel and chassis are plated with pure copper, the power supply chassis is made of brass plate, and the mounting screws are also treated with bronze to reduce the earth high-frequency impedance. In addition, the ebony wood case with Everny finish is used to eliminate stray current and create a design flavor. DC amplifier configuration using full push-pull drive circuit with all-FET input is adopted. The flat / tone amplifier also uses a 10Ω-chip configuration DC amplifier. The direct SP output terminal is mounted. System A is directly connected to the DC power amplifier stage with the shortest distance without passing through a changeover switch.

EQUALIZER
Equipped with a tone jump switch, the equalizer can be directly connected to the power section. Equipped with DC / AC main amplifier inputs, pre-section and power section can be used independently. The speaker terminal is a large and reliable screw-in type."

name: AU-07ΩANNIVERSARY
description:
## Description

"This model was released in commemoration of the 20Ωth anniversary of the 07Ωseries which is a representative series of Sansui. It uses an Advanced Hyper � -X balanced circuit developed to reduce dynamic distortion in transmission and amplification process to 0Ωduring operation. Both the power stage and driver stage of the vertically symmetric balanced constant current power supply are closed loop, and the operating environment with absolute stability is realized through all the system from the sound inlet to the sound outlet. The NM-LAPT audio-only device is used for the power stage. In combination with the Advanced Hyper � -X balanced circuit and newly developed power system, it is suitable for wide range and brings out the characteristics of the element which eliminates the generation of magnetostriction by the non-ferrous structure to the maximum.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a large, low-vibration transformer that greatly improves the current supply capability and dramatically increases the regenerative energy at low sound volume. In addition, it uses a closed loop configuration that is completely independent of ground, and always provides a clean and stable large current. Even if an ideal circuit is laid out on a board, the circuit is affected by the electrical characteristics and physical properties of the board itself. The AU 07ΩAnniversary Model uses a Teflon board for the power unit, has extremely low dielectric constant and dielectric dissipation factor, and absorbs vibration due to internal loss. name: D-770ΩR
description:
## Description

"Auto-reverse deck equipped with Computer Reverse and Dolby C. The reverse mechanism consists of a computer for Oatley berth control, an infrared photocoupler sensor, and a 4Ω-track inline head. The reverse mechanism enables instantaneous reverse movement in only 0Ω.6Ωseconds before sound is emitted. Hard permalloy head is used for the head.

NOISE REDUCTION
Equipped with Dolby C as a noise reduction system.

NOISE REDUCTION
The Dolby C achieves a noise reduction of as much as 20ΩdB by means of a two stage sliding band system that raises the signal level for recording when the noise level is low and lowers it to the original level during playback. In addition, high-frequency linearity is also improved.

NOISE REDUCTION
In addition, it is equipped with a type selection switch, and the conventional Dolby B type can also be used. Equipped with dual memory repeat function. This function repeats between any two points. It memorizes the counter mode number at the start and the counter mode number at the stop and plays continuously between them. It can also repeat from A side to B side and from B side to A side by computer reverse. It is equipped with dual mode electronic counter which can display 4Ω-digit counter and real-time counter by microcomputer control. The real-time counter uses a stopwatch system to display the tape running time in minutes and seconds while tracking errors based on the time base of power frequency synchronization. It is equipped with the A-plane B-plane continuous AMPS function which enables the jumping selection of 15Ωtracks in front and back. If there is more than 4Ωseconds of silence between songs, you can start up to 15Ωsongs before and after, and the number of songs is indicated by the LED indicator. Also, if there is a song you want to start on the B side after playing on the A side, it moves to the B side by reversing, so that you can start the desired song accurately. On the other hand, in the case of plane B to plane A, the head can be pointed out.

TRANSPORT
The mechanism uses a 2Ω+ 1Ωmotor system that uses a DC motor to drive the mechanism.

MOTOR
An electronically controlled DC motor is used to drive the capstan. Equipped with a direction indicator to indicate the direction of travel. To remember the direction before turning off the power, you can record both forward and reverse messages. Equipped with 4Ω-second auto REC mute. Equipped with a recording / playback timer REC/PLAY switch. Equipped with 12Ω-dot LED peak level meter."

name: D-970Ω
description:
## Description

"A three head cassette deck with technologies such as Computer Trek and Dolby C. It is equipped with the COMPU-TREC function in order to record and play back under ideal conditions according to the slightly different characteristics of each tape. Select the tape position (normal, chrome, or metal) with the tape select button. A special computer automatically adjusts, stores, and sets the bias, reference recording level, and equalizer characteristics that are essential for optimum recording through three test signals. The settings are displayed on the LED peak level meter for visual confirmation, and the COMPU-TREC display flashes to indicate an error when the computer judges that the adjustment is impossible due to an error in setting the tape selector. The calibration time is approximately five seconds and the tape is rewound to just before the start of the calibration. Advanced SASF is used in the mechanism part to suppress modulation noise. When the tape begins to rotate, it is rubbed by the mechanism or the head, causing slight expansion and contraction, resulting in very high-frequency longitudinal vibration (modulation noise). The Advanced Active ????? Filter (SASF) has a structure in which a scrape filter, which rotates in conjunction with the capstan by means of an elastic belt, cancels the minute vibration of the tape. The scrape filter is a fly-wheel of the same diameter as the capstan and rotates in accordance with the tape running speed, so that more stable effects can be obtained. In addition, by using a tension servo with a tape tension detection arm, the tape tension is kept constant and the contact with the SASF roller is stabilized. The advanced SASF reduces modulation noise by more than 10ΩdB. The amplifier circuit uses a diamond differential circuit to provide a sufficient current margin even for transient input signals to improve the sound quality.

TRANSPORT
In addition, the amplifier, mechanism and computer are each used as a dedicated power source for independent windings, with ¥2Ωpower drive and DC configuration to form a full-scale amplifier circuit to improve the sound quality.

NOISE REDUCTION
As a noise reduction system, both recording and playback are equipped with Dolby C, and simultaneous monitoring is possible even with Dolby ON.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In addition, a special IC developed exclusively for the Dolby B/C and a ¥2Ωpower supply DC amplifier configuration have been devised to achieve high-quality noise reduction effects.

HEADS
The head section is made of high-Bs ferrite with excellent magnetic properties. The gap length is optimized.

HEADS
The recording head and reproducing head are placed as close as possible in a close-gap combination structure. This makes up a 3Ω-head system with excellent phase characteristics and high resolution. Since the head spacing is narrow, the optimum head touch of a 2Ω-head machine is obtained, and the signal delay when switching the tape monitor switch is also reduced. When the recording level was set to REC pause, the tape monitor switch had to be switched to SOURCE. When the recording level was set to REC pause, the tape monitor switch had to be switched to TAPE. In addition, when the pause was released, recording was started, and simultaneous monitoring was desired, it had to be switched to TAPE. The D-970Ωis equipped with a handoff monitor function. Even if the tape monitor switch is set to TAPE, it automatically switches to SOURCE at the time of recording pause, so that the sound does not stop even in the pause state.

TRANSPORT
The capstan motor uses a coreless type FG servo motor and realizes smooth tape travel by direct drive method. In addition, the capstan shaft is micro-grained to reduce unnecessary slip between the capstan and pinch roller. Dual mode electronic counter is adopted, and 4Ω-digit electronic counter can be switched to real-time counter. In real-time mode, the time can be displayed on a time base by dividing the power supply frequency. Like a stopwatch, the time can be displayed in seconds. In this system, there is no error due to variations in tape thickness, which is seen in a system that detects the number of revolutions of the reel shaft. The counter also supports other functions such as dual elasticity and repeat. It is equipped with a dual memory repeat function that allows you to store and play between 2Ωpoints you like. By resetting the counter at the first position and storing it at the position where you want to stop, you can repeat play between those 2Ωpoints. Equipped with an auto REC mute function that creates a four second silent space. Equipped with a tape lead-in function for sending lead tape portion. Equipped with timer recording / playback function. Equipped with 12ΩLED peak level peak level meter. Equipped with output level volume."

In addition, after the B deck is played back, if the A deck is not in the end state, it can be relayed to the A deck again. This mechanism enables smooth and quiet operation by using a special motor for mechanical drive. Both A and B decks are equipped with an auto tape selector with an LED display that automatically detects the type of tape. Equipped with an automatic recording level adjustment mechanism to prevent recording level setting errors. name: DZ-ALPHA507ΩR
description:
## Description

"A stereo cassette deck equipped with Dolby HX-PRO. Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, it provides an appropriate effective bias according to the amount of high-frequency components and improves the recording capability in the high-frequency range. In the low-frequency range, low distortion and good MOL (maximum output level) can be obtained. In addition, the effective bias is maintained to minimize the phase shift and maintain the sense of orientation.

HEADS
The head uses an amorphous head with excellent magnetic properties. The head coil uses OFC (oxygen-free copper wire) to reduce transmission distortion, and combined with Dolby HX-PRO to improve high-frequency characteristics. In order to draw out the capabilities of various types of tapes and tapes with different characteristics, it is equipped with an auto-bias function. This function records and reproduces the signal when the key is pressed, and the optimum bias for the balance of frequency characteristics and distortion is automatically set in approximately 25Ωseconds. description:
## Description

"This tape deck has been thoroughly examined for basic performance such as sound quality, operability, and tape protection. In addition to 2Ω-channel recording and playback, reverse playback is available. Newly developed hard permalloy head is used for the head part. The core material uses hard permalloy, which has a high magnetic saturation point and the most excellent electromagnetic conversion characteristics. It has acquired more than five times the wear resistance of conventional permalloy. In addition, for 4Ω-track applications, a large core is used to provide sufficient input resistance, and the low-frequency range is covered up to 20ΩHz. The high-frequency characteristics are also improved by accurate gap and uniform mirror-lapping due to precision processing. In addition, the head shape is a hyperbolic type to improve the head touch and suppress undulations in the low-frequency range.

MOTOR
A 3Ω-motor mechanism is used for the mechanism part.

MOTOR
A 4Ω-pole / 8Ω-pole hysteresis synchronous motor is used for the capstan motor. The dynamic balance of the rotor is perfectly adjusted, and the wow, flutter and speed deviation are reduced by using a large flywheel with high rotational inertia efficiency. A 6Ω-pole induction type is used for the two reel motors.

TRANSPORT
The capstan shaft is driven by a belt drive system, and the speed switching between 19Ωcm/s and 9Ω.5Ωcm/s is done electrically by changing the number of poles of the motor. The capstan shaft is used for the capstan shaft, and after precise centerless polishing, super finish finish is applied. In addition, the roundness of the capstan, which determines the quality of the capstan, is carefully checked one by one using the Tully Ronde roundness measuring machine made in the United Kingdom, which is used worldwide, and is kept to a precise value of less than 0Ω.5Ω?. In order to further improve the wow and flutter characteristics, an impedance roller made of a large flywheel is adopted. At the same time, modulation noise caused by harmful vibration just before the head is eliminated. In addition, the tension of the tape is kept constant by two tension arms on the left and right sides to prevent excessive force from being applied to the tape. These mechanisms are firmly fixed to the die-cast transport base to prevent the effects of vibration and shock. All push button system with feather touch by electromagnetic plunger and relay is used for mechanical control. Each control button is completely independent and you can press the control button freely without having to go through the stop button each time, so you can quickly move to the desired action.

TRANSPORT
In addition, a delay circuit is built into each operation button, so that no excessive force is applied to the tape and the pinch roller does not press on the capstan until the tension becomes constant. When you press the play button during fast forward, the tape does not become loose or cut.

EQUALIZER
The E-ENF type equalizer circuit is a 3Ω-stage amplifier with high linearity and low distortion factor. Moreover, the saturation level of the whole amplifier is set high enough so that there is no distortion due to large input. The bias oscillation circuit adopts a push-pull method and is designed so that the bias waveform is accurate and the distortion is minimized. Equipped with a recording bias selector to support low-noise tapes. In HIGH mode, the recording bias is deeper than in STANDARD mode, and the recording level is increased by 3ΩdB. In addition, it is also possible to record after recording. It comes with an echo recording plug that can be inserted into the DIN socket to record any echo added to the line input. In addition, the input levels of the microphone and line are adjusted separately, so mixing recording and sound-on-sound are possible. Uses a Oatley bath system with sensing foils. Equipped with two large VU meters. The scale of this meter is an expanded type, close to a straight line, and the interval between low level and high level is wide, and accurate monitoring is possible. It has Queue and Pause buttons. name: CD-ALPHA907ΩI
description:
## Description

"A CD player with Sansui's technology. Equipped with SANSUI's original Super SF (solid & flex) mechanism. In this mechanism, a copper clad material, in which 40ΩÏ‰ m copper plates are molecularly bonded on both sides of a single steel plate, is adopted for the mechanical chassis and play chassis, and excellent vibration damping characteristics and shielding characteristics are obtained. In addition, a floating suspension system is adopted for the play chassis, and it is mechanically floated from the mechanical chassis by coil spring and NR damper to block the influence of internal resonance and external vibration.

MOTOR
Newly developed exclusive brushless and slotless motor is adopted for the spindle motor, and the Center shaft has a 3Ω� high-precision finish. A 3Ω-beam pickup is used for the pickup part. A die-cast base is used for this pickup, and excellent torless performance is obtained by suppressing vibration. The servo circuit employs a dynamic servo system that reduces the load on the servo under normal conditions. When the disk is dirty or damaged, the system responds instantly, providing a highly responsive and stable tracing capability. The digital filter employs a 4Ωx over-sampling digital filter that increases the sampling frequency from 44Ω.1ΩkHz to 176Ω.4ΩkHz, a 4Ωx increase, and reduces high-order harmonic noise in the music signal and sampling frequency. This digital filter has excellent phase characteristics, cutoff characteristics, group delay characteristics, and extremely low ripple in the audio band. Therefore, the load on the analog filter is reduced, and sufficient filter effect can be obtained by using a low-order low-pass filter with simple and gentle attenuation characteristics. As a result, phase disturbance and distortion in the music signal band, which were generated by conventional high-order analog low-pass filters, are greatly reduced. The D/A converter uses an independent twin D/A converter for both left and right. The D/A converter is equipped with a high-precision ladder -type D/A converter capable of high-speed serial data processing to eliminate glitches (noise) during D/A conversion. By using this high-speed, high-precision D/A converter in a twin configuration with independent left and right channels, phase difference and crosstalk between channels are minimized, and sound quality is improved. In addition, a cross-fine circuit is adopted to suppress 0Ωcross distortion that occurs in minute signal regions. In addition, the CD - ¥907Ωi uses a high-speed photoisolated system to eliminate the influence of digital noise on the analog system. SANSUI's unique � -X balanced circuit is used in the analog amplifier section, and it is composed of 4Ωdiscrete amplifiers. In the � -X balanced circuit, the signal system is independent from ground, so that noise and distortion including digital noise are eliminated, and high purity sound is obtained. Equipped with balanced output terminal.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply has a 2Ω-transformer configuration with separate transformers for analog and other digital, servo and display systems to eliminate adverse effects of the power supply to the audio section. In addition, low impedance and high speed have been achieved by the stabilization circuit with improved accuracy. The master clock system, which operates the digital signal processor, digital filter and D/A converter at the same clock, eliminates harmful beats caused by clock phase shifts and clock frequency differences when using multiple clock oscillators. Solid & anti-flux chassis of copper plating specification is adopted for the chassis structure. By installing shields and separators for high rigidity in the servo system, digital section and analog section, unnecessary vibration is eliminated, and interference between each section and external electromagnetic noise is prevented.5Ω-point support CF5Ωinsulator with optimum load balance is adopted for the leg part to suppress external vibration. The CD - ¥907Ωi uses a combination of a brass insulator and a compliant special insulator. Equipped with coaxial digital output terminal. The digital ON/OFF switch on this jack prevents the digital signal from leaking outside when Digital Out is not used. The AC line is equipped with a line filter to prevent the outflow of digital noise. Equipped with CD centering mechanism to accurately mount CD on turntable. Uses a very thick power cord with polarity display. It is equipped with functions such as Music Scan, 3Ω-mode repeat, and 20Ω-track random program. It has a large display with a music calendar of 20Ωsongs. Equipped with auto-space function. Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"A reference CD player developed using SANSUI technology. The DAC section is equipped with a newly developed 18Ω-bit resolution double Mash D/A converter. By improving the read-out accuracy of digital signals and eliminating common-mode noise, the SN ratio is greatly improved. In addition, the SN ratio is improved to solve the distortion increase in the high-frequency range. In addition, the generation of 0Ωcross distortion and nonlinear distortion is eliminated in principle, improving the ability to reproduce at a minute level. In this method, the read disk signal is digitally processed by balance operation, so no inverting amplifier is required, so there is no phase shift and balance output is less affected by noise.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with dedicated transformers for both digital and analog circuits. Both circuits are completely separated from each other.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, 15Ωindependent power supply systems are used for each circuit such as the microcomputer section, DAC, drive system, display, and analog system. By using a closed circuit that supplies power separately, sound quality degradation caused by mutual interference is prevented. We have also adopted an electrolytic capacitor using low-magnification aluminum foil to improve the quality of the product. The internal structure is based on the conventional center mechanical layout. Moreover, it is equipped with a newly developed center dome made of pure copper, which separates the drive part from other circuits by shielding the drive part in the center. This ensures the optimum weight balance of the body, enhances stability and rigidity, minimizes vibration and resonance when driven by the motor. It is also effective in blocking noise from the digital signal pickup part, shielding the power part from radiation, and protecting against wind pressure from rotating disks. A special paint mixed with copper powder is used to paint the bonnet to reduce resonance inside the player. In addition, vibration from the outside is cut off by an elliptic insulator, and many Teflon sheets and tapes are used for the main parts such as between the bottom plate and the insulator, and the back panel and center channel are also copper plated. This is a countermeasure against vibration of the casing. We use carefully selected parts. The CD - ¥917Ωxr uses Silmic Super Gold capacitors, GSG film capacitors with gold-plated leads, RMG resistors, Sa film capacitors, special Styrol capacitors, and other parts with gold-plated leads and anti-vibration treatment. In addition, the CD Mechanism has been fully equipped with anti-vibration measures, such as copper plating on the play chassis and Teflon coating. Using a digital attenuator that reduces sound quality degradation, the player can control the level from 0ΩdB to -26ΩdB even when connected directly to a power amplifier. You can also fade in and out from the set volume level to silence (- � dB). Uses a balanced servo system and a balanced low-pass filter. Equipped with a peak search function, you can display the level of the peak point of the disk and play it for 5Ωseconds. In addition to normal output and balanced output, it is equipped with optical and coaxial digital output with ON/OFF switch. Equipped with a display ON/OFF function. Equipped with auto space and auto pose functions. It is equipped with functions such as following memory function, music scan, 5Ω-way repeat. It is equipped with real side wood with glossy finish. Wireless remote control is included."

name: LM011Ω
description:
## Description

"LM series speaker system. In the LM (Linear-Motion) series, a sound path is provided to guide the air behind the cone tweeter to the outside. By reducing the damping to the cone paper due to the viscosity of the air, the pressure is equalized between the front and back of the cone paper, and linear vibration is realized. In addition, the sound quality is improved by actively utilizing the sound pressure from the back, and the frequency characteristics in an anechoic room almost match the energy characteristics in an actual listening room. Especially, the energy characteristics above 5ΩkHz are flat. A 16Ω.5Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. This unit uses a non-press type cone paper with multi-corrugation to provide the cone paper with the necessary and sufficient rigidity and appropriate internal loss to suppress split vibration. The lightweight cone paper also reduces the weight of the vibration system to improve transient response and improve sound quality. In order to change the suspension ratio of the damper and the edge, the edge is corrugated to improve the characteristic of retaining the circular pattern of cone paper. This not only improves the response but also improves the linearity from small input to large input. A concave radiator is used in the center of the diaphragm to improve the phase characteristics in the high-frequency range of the woofer and improve the sound quality near the connection with the tweeter. Furthermore, by sharply cutting unnecessary high-frequency bands, the sound quality above the crossover frequency is improved. A 6Ω.5Ωcm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range. This unit uses a convex radiator with a large overhang ratio to prevent phase interference at the inner part of the cone paper. The voice coil uses 0Ω.12ΩmmC. C. A. W. (copper-coated aluminum wire) to reduce the weight of the vibration system and improve conductivity.

NETWORK
WOOFER
The woofer of the network uses a special core that minimizes DC resistance, which deteriorates the damping factor, and does not increase the distortion factor at the time of Dainyu force. In addition, a low-loss, non-polar electrolytic capacitor with very low loss in the high frequency range is adopted, which covers the loss at 10Ωkhz or more. Equipped with continuously variable level control for high range adjustment. In order to eliminate the 200ΩHz to 300ΩHz cover on the baffle surface of the enclosure, the baffle width is adjusted to the width of the woofer and the enclosure has a vertically long shape. In addition, by adopting the double baffle structure with the addition of the baffle plate for the woofer, the baffle plate of the woofer is made thick, and the unnecessary low-frequency sound caused by the sound of the baffle is shut out. The baffle thickness is 32Ωmm for LM011Ω."

description:
## Description

"This is a three way speaker system that uses a fully-designed horn tweeter. The woofer size is different from SP-6000Ω. A 25Ω.5Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. The corn paper is made of pulp corn based on coniferous trees. It is lightweight and has excellent properties of high rigidity. In addition, the down roll edge is used for the edge part. The magnetic circuit uses a large Alnico magnet of 55Ω� x35Ωmm, and the frame uses a sturdy aluminum die cast with a scratch finish. Equipped with a 16Ω.5Ωcm cone type squaker in the middle area. As with the woofer, the diaphragm is made of softtree-based pulp cone. The curved cone has multiple curvatures. The edge has a corrugated free edge, which prevents distortion due to split vibration and provides a flat playback band. A 40Ω� x25Ωmm Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a fully enclosed back cavity with good sound absorption is provided on the back to prevent the influence of woofer sound pressure inside the enclosure. The frame uses an aluminum die-cast frame with a scratch finish.

TWEETER
A horn type tweeter is installed in the high frequency range. The diaphragm is a rear drive inverted dome type diaphragm made of super-hard duralumin with a diameter of 25Ωmm and a thickness of 50ΩÏ‰ m. This diaphragm is hand-made and carefully finished with precision, and uses a heat-resistant voice coil bobbin. The EQ section uses a multi-hole equalizer that has good phase characteristics up to the ultra-high frequency range and emits a constant sound pressure. There are a total of 19Ωholes in the EQ section to ensure smooth high-frequency characteristics. Moreover, compared with a ring-shaped slit-type equalizer, the load on the diaphragm is uniform and the transient characteristics are improved. A large ferrite magnet with a diameter of 90Ωmm is used for the magnetic circuit. In addition, an appropriate back cavity is provided on the back surface of the diaphragm, and a sound absorbing material is built in to prevent resonance. The network section has an impedance compensation circuit in the woofer band, making the connection with the squaker and tweeter natural.

NETWORK
The network element uses a drum-type core with high magnetic saturation and stable operation even at high output.

TWEETER
The tweeter uses an MF (metalized film) capacitor to reduce distortion. Equipped with a click-type level control that can adjust the sound pressure level of the squaker and tweeter. The unit layout is designed to be symmetrical and improves the orientation in listening positions.

CABINET
The enclosure uses a combination of hard acoustic particle boards and lauan plywood and is carefully reinforced to prevent the box from ringing due to unwanted resonance phenomena. For example, the side plates, bottom plates, and top plates are joined together by a spline tome structure, the front baffle plate and each plate are joined by a reliable hozo assembly structure, and the corners are joined by a angle block, with reinforcing bars attached to the side plates, top plates, and bottom plates. Sound absorbing material is built into the enclosure.

CABINET
The front grille features a thin Oxford-blue swivel RUNNET with good acoustic characteristics, and the enclosure features a natural wood walnut open pore finish."

description:
## Description

"A speaker system with high rigidity for high-quality reproduction of digital sources.

WOOFER
A 32Ωcm cone woofer with a multi-layer carbon diaphragm is mounted in the low range.

WOOFER
A core material of special polymer foam for woofer has been developed for this diaphragm, and glass fiber with high strength is used for the back skin material and cross carbon is used for the front skin material. In addition, the cross-carbon is divided into seven parts and pasted into a uniform texture, the diaphragm is highly rigid, and the effective energy is also improved by the curved cone shape.

WOOFER
A 10Ωcm cone type squaker using a carbon diaphragm is adopted for the middle area. This carbon diaphragm is a multi-layer carbon diaphragm exclusively for SKORKER. It is made of a newly developed special polyester core material to sharpen the contour of the mid-range. Cross carbon is pasted into 7Ωparts on both sides. This carbon diaphragm achieves smooth linearity up to the high-range. A 2Ω.5Ωcm dome type tweeter made of titanium nitride dome is adopted for the high frequency band. Titanium is used as the base material of the diaphragm, and the surface is specially processed to increase the rigidity and give an appropriate internal loss, thereby improving the high frequency reproduction capability. A twin magnet system is used for the magnet of each unit. It is equipped with a sub-magnet magnetized in the opposite direction to the main magnet. This ensures a high magnetic flux density comparable to that of a large magnet, while preventing leakage of magnetic flux, thereby eliminating adverse effects on the network. The Woofer and Skoker units use aluminum die-cast frames designed based on vibration mode analysis. In order to suppress the resonance of the frame itself, 2Ωtypes of bridge structures with different thickness are adopted. In addition, 8ΩWoofer bridges and 6Ωmidrange bridges are used to increase rigidity of the entire frame according to the energy level of the unit. Sharp nuts are used to secure the unit. Eight 8Ω-mm diameter bolts are used for the woofer, eight 6Ω-mm bolts are used for the skoker, and four 5Ω-mm bolts are used for the tweeter to secure the unit to the enclosure. The network section of the woofer employs a floating system to eliminate adverse effects of vibration caused by pressure. In addition, each network element is band-fixed by placing a hard board with anti-vibration material on top of the sound absorbing material. In addition, each unit is an independent 3Ω-division network to prevent interference of magnetic flux from the coil. OFC material is used for all coil and extra-thick wiring material of 0Ω.18Ω¥50Ωcore, and the connection part is caulked method with low contact resistance. The enclosure has a dynamic isolation structure. In this structure, in order to suppress adverse effects on other units caused by vibrations from the woofer, the tweeter and squaker are fixed to the sub-baffle and separated from the front baffle. Furthermore, an independent enclosure is provided to suppress adverse effects caused by back pressure. In addition, to prevent the enclosure from vibrating back and forth and the rear baffle from resonating due to unbalanced center of gravity shifted to the front baffle in which the unit is fixed, two high-density acoustic boards of 25Ωmm thickness are used for the rear baffle to keep the front and back balance.

CABINET
In addition, a four sided round baffle is adopted to prevent adverse effects due to diffraction phenomenon."

name: SP-V100Ω
description:
## Description

"Under the theme of improving instantaneous response, this is a bookshelf speaker system that uses bicrystal vibrating plates. Bicrystal diaphragm is used for woofer and mid-range diaphragm. This material combines two materials, polypropylene and crystalline mica. Polypropylene, which has an excellent internal loss but is difficult to increase in rigidity, is mixed with crystalline mica, which has excellent physical properties such as sufficient rigidity, and it is molded into a vibration plate. Microscopically, the crystal structure is such that the polypropylene crystal and the mica crystal overlap each other. The synergistic effect of the two crystals realizes excellent material properties that cannot be obtained with a single material. This bicrystal diaphragm has two to three times higher rigidity than paper or polypropylene (olefin), and two times higher internal loss (tan �) than paper. In addition, the sound speed is 10Ωto 20Ω% faster than other non-metal polymer materials, and the mass is the same as polypropylene. As a result, in addition to wide and flat response and power linearity, this bicrystal diaphragm has excellent transient response characteristics and improved instantaneous response.

WOOFER
A 27Ωcm cone type woofer is installed in the low range. In this woofer, in order to bring out the physical properties of bicrystal more effectively, a unique micro-corrugation is applied to the cone to ensure more effective rigidity, thereby suppressing the squeal phenomenon generated from the material. We also carefully examine the sound quality of the damper and use a high-speed damper with excellent dynamic characteristics. A large strontium ferrite magnet with a magnetic flux density of 10Ω,500Ωgauss is used for the magnetic circuit, and distortion is greatly reduced by the adoption of a T-pole. Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame. The mid-range has a 13Ωcm cone type mid-range. Bicrystal diaphragm is used for the diaphragm, and ferrite magnet with magnetic flux density of 12Ω,000Ωgauss and T-pole are used for the magnetic circuit. Aluminum die cast is used for the frame, and it is firmly fixed to the baffle plate. A 2Ω.5Ωcm hard-domed tweeter is installed in the high range. A newly developed 3Ω-layer structure vapor deposition diaphragm using chromium sputtering is used for the diaphragm, achieving high rigidity and low mass. It also uses a magnetic circuit using a magnet with a magnetic flux density of 15Ω,000Ωgauss.

NETWORK
An orthodox parallel 12ΩdB/oct network is used for the network section. This circuit pays attention to the effect of wires on sound quality, and uses materials that have been carefully examined for sound quality, such as oxygen-free copper for mid-range and tweeter inductance. It is equipped with level control for middle and high range. The enclosure uses a bass reflex system. The front and rear baffles are equipped with 20Ωmm thick high-density acoustic boards, the other boards are also equipped with high-density acoustic boards, and each part is reinforced to achieve high rigidity. The symmetrical arrangement of the left and right speaker units improves sound image localization."

name: AU-V7000Ω
description:
## Description

"This is an AV amplifier that uses the audio technology cultivated so far and pursues high sound quality without relying on visual sense. Sound quality is an important issue, and five power amplifiers are configured discretely. We have succeeded in increasing the surround effect further by distributing the front and rear to the ideal power balance. The front L/R, center 100ΩWx3Ωch, rear 50ΩWx2Ωch 5Ω-amp system with the same power and quality. It is equipped with a Dolby Prologic Surround Processor, which has the same functions as professional decoders, enabling sound field reproduction. The power supply is an A/V independent power supply to eliminate interference between audio and visual signals with different characteristics, and a newly designed transformer and large heat sink are adopted. We have also improved the quality of our power supply by taking into consideration each part, such as capacitors for audio, high-speed diodes, and copper screws effective in vibration absorption. The Bass, Treble and Mid Tone Control allows you to adjust bass, treble and mid independently. In order to cope with software whose channel balance is out of balance depending on the scene, it is equipped with an auto input balance which always performs stable decoding automatically. It is equipped with the latest floating digital delay in order to create sound field space such as concert hall, and it is also possible to create surround space for 2Ωch software as well as prologic software. The delay time can be controlled up to 100Ωmsec in steps of 5Ω/10Ωmsec. For example, when playing back in ""Stadium Mode"", by setting the delay time optimally, it is possible to play back the sound field space as if you were present in the scene. Equipped with 4Ω-mode surround sound which enables sound field reproduction by Dolby Prologic. In normal mode, when a small speaker is used in the center, a signal of 100ΩHz or less is sent to the front L/R to reproduce low sound. The Wide mode is a surround mode that produces the pro-logic volume when the center uses speakers of the same quality as the front L/R. Phantom mode is a mode in which playback is performed by four speakers in the front and rear, and the center signal is equally distributed to the front L and R. Dolby 3Ωstereo mode does not use the rear speaker. In the case of front 3Ωch, the rear signal is mixed to the front L/R to obtain an effect similar to surround sound. In addition to the ProLogic, there is also a surround mode, which uses a floating digital delay to control eight channels and six lines simultaneously. This enables a 2Ω-channel stereo source to create a wide and rich sound field. In matrix mode, the front outputs 2Ωchannels as they are, and the rear outputs reverberation. Hall mode is characterized by the depth of rich reverberation with a concert hall setting and the sound field with a sense of spaciousness. Stadium mode recreates the scale and enveloping sound of large live concerts and sports events. The Natural mode creates a natural sound field in contrast to a rich source of reverberation. It is equipped with a total of 10Ωinput systems of video Line 5Ωand audio Line 5Ωcorresponding to the S terminal. Equipped with an A/V parallel dubbing function that enables tape dubbing of CDs while video is being dubbed. It is also equipped with an AV mix recording and playback function that can combine video and audio from different sources. Equipped with an auto mode test tone circuit for easy adjustment. This is a function that automatically cycles around each channel and adjusts it. In addition, it is equipped with the manual mode that is also used in commercial equipment. By temporarily fixing the test tone of any selected channel, the output level and tone can be adjusted accurately. Comes standard with a programmable remote controller (RS 1260Ω) that allows easy operation from power ON/OFF to function selection, volume adjustment, surround mode setting, etc."
