name: AU-V7500Ω
description:
## Description

"This AV surround amplifier was developed with the goal of developing an AV amplifier with the same quality as pure audio. There are 2Ωtypes, AU-V7500ΩG in gold color and AU-V7500ΩB in BlackCar color. Equipped with Dolby Pro-Logic Decoder and supports Dolby Pro-Logic Surround. To maximize the effects of Dolby Pro-Logic Surround, you can adjust the channel balance of the inputs with the Auto Input Balance feature, which provides stable decoding. This feature allows you to enjoy Pro-Logic Surround at your discretion without having to adjust each software individually. Four surround modes with pro-logic playback are available. In normal mode, a small speaker is used in the center, and the signal below 100ΩHz is sent to the front L/R for playback. In wide mode, a speaker of the same quality as the front L/R is used in the center. Phantom mode is a mode in which the sound is played back by four speakers at the front and rear, and the center signal is equally divided into front L and front R for playback. The Dolby 3Ωstereo mode is designed for the front 3Ωch without the use of the rear speaker. The rear signal is mixed with the front L/R to produce a surround effect. In addition to the Dolby Pro Logic, you can choose from a matrix that outputs the front 2Ωas it is and outputs the reverberation sound from the rear, a hall that reproduces rich reverberation with a concert hall, a stadium that reproduces the scale of a wide space live concert or sports event, and Natural that reduces the sound field that spreads naturally against the rich source of reverberation components. It is equipped with a digital delay function to create sound field space more realistically. In addition, this digital delay operates at a high S/N ratio with an input level control function for adjusting the optimum input level. The 5Ωdiscrete power amplifiers enhance the surround effect by considering the front / rear power balance. By designing the front and center outputs equally, the ideal condition of ""L/R / Center drive with the same quality and power"" of Dolby Pro Logic is satisfied. name: SAX-1000Ω
description:
## Description

"A high-grade stereo comprehensive amplifier that combines a high-output low-distortion audio section with a high-performance tuner.

POWER AMPLIFIER
GT tube 7591Ωis adopted for the power amplifier section to constitute a push-pull circuit of fixed bias system. Combined with an ultra-wide-band output transformer, a music power of 96ΩW and an effective output of 38Ω/38ΩW are achieved at a low distortion rate of 1Ω%. The FM tuner uses a cascode system with two stage New Vista and three stage variable capacitor. It also incorporates a double limiter that eliminates noise regardless of the strong or weak electric field as a noise limiter, and a muting switch (squelch circuit) that automatically separates the low-frequency amplification stage when the input voltage of the receiver drops and eliminates inter-station noise that occurs during channel selection. In addition, it is equipped with an AFC circuit for enjoying long-term stable FM and an SCA filter for shutting out interference of SCA broadcasting. The preamplifier section consists of four transistors to reduce hum and noise. Equipped with 8Ωinput systems and Route 3Ωterminals, it can be used for various applications. In particular, two Phono terminals are provided for easy use of the MC type cartridge. Equipped with MT9ΩP type socket, MC type cartridge can be used by inserting SANSUI matching transformers A-603Ωand A-604Ω. Switching matrix method is adopted for FM multi-circuit. name: SAX-2000Ω
description:
## Description

"Top-of-the-line solid state FM/AM receiver with a tuner with built-in FET. In the FM front-end section, a 4Ω-series varicon dedicated to FM, RF first stage and RF second stage of FET, and a specially selected noiseless silicon transistor is used for the mixer and oscillator circuit. In addition, the IF section of 5Ω-stage amplification and 4Ω-stage limiter provide a wide Takamasu, high stability, low noise and low distortion. A two stage front-end AGC circuit and a one stage IF circuit enable stable reception even in strong electric fields. Switching system is adopted for the multi-circuit. The AM tuner section is a dedicated circuit instead of a common circuit for the FM tuner, and uses RF1Ω-stage and 3Ω-stage varicon. This improves the AM noise characteristics and selectivity, such as the beat and whistle noise typical of AM radio waves. In addition, it is equipped with a ferrite bar antenna, and the electric field strength can be switched by a long / short distance switch. All silicon transistors are used for the FM and audio sections. Especially, noiseless silicon transistors are used for the head amplifier to improve distortion and S/N ratio at low output.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier uses a complimentary service Darlington circuit SEPP-ITL-OTL system that uses a mesa silicon transistor as the power transistor. In addition, a pure electronic power transistor protection circuit and a double-type protection circuit using a short-cut fuse are adopted. The power supply uses a power transformer specially developed by SANSUI for transistor amplifiers. In addition, a ham proof belt and short ring are attached so that the power supply ham does not come out. The intermediate amplifier section uses NF-type tone control with low-noise silicon transistors. Also, since it is a friction type double volume, each channel returns to a different sound quality."

name: QRX-2000Ω
description:
## Description

"A 4Ω-channel receiver with a newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit. Equipped with QS Barrio matrix circuit developed by SANSUI. This circuit applies an acoustic-psychological phenomenon called directional masking. When strong and weak sound simultaneously reach the ear, the direction of the weak sound is masked and becomes unclear. This phenomenon is electronically incorporated into a 4Ω-channel circuit. Compared to conventional 3Ω-dB-type RM decoders, this method provides theoretically infinite channel separation, so the QRX2000Ωis set to the most desirable value for music playback. It also provides more accurate localization and better sound quality than conventional RM decoders. Equipped with a function switch that can select various 4Ω-channel effects. If you press the QS Synthesizer switch, you can enjoy two channel records and other four channels with the new QS Synthesizer function. The QS Regular Matrix combines the traditional RM with the Barrio Matrix to provide high quality QS4Ωchannel playback. The phase matrix uses a unique QS Barrio matrix circuit to provide good separation for SQ playback. Discrete devices support playback of 4Ω-channel tape decks and CD-4Ω-demodulators. All stages are directly connected to the semi-power complimentary service circuit for the power amplifier. In the QRX 2000Ω, attention is paid to the heat dissipation effect of the power transistor, and each channel stage is unitized and mounted on the motherboard. The front-end of the FM tuner section uses a dual-gate MOS FET and a precision 3Ω-row varicon for higher sensitivity. The IF stage uses four ceramic filters and the MPX section uses a dedicated IC for stable sound quality.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a power transformer of one rank higher class, the power capacitor is equipped with a ripple filter at 4Ω,700ΩÏ‰ F, and a stabilized power supply circuit is used to improve the SN ratio and stability. It is equipped with functions such as tone control, loudness and tape monitor."

description:
## Description

"A top-of-the-line 4Ω-channel receiver with built-in newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit that supports all 4Ω-channel systems. The QS Synthesizer / Decoder section incorporates a newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit in addition to synthesizer / decoder functions, phase shifters and phase matrix functions. The 90Ω� phase shifter is designed to solve the problem of the conventional matrix circuit in which the phases of the two rear speakers were reversed. On the decoder side, the phases of the left rear speakers are shifted by -90Ω¥, and the phases of the right rear speakers are shifted by + 90Ω�. The phases between the rear speakers are On the encoder side, the reverse operation is performed. The newly developed QS Barrio matrix circuit is an application of an acoustic phenomenon called directional masking. By instantaneously changing the matrix coefficient of the input signal, the reproduced signal is controlled so that the directivity becomes clear, and the separation is improved. Theoretically, the QS Barrio matrix circuit can obtain infinite separation between each channel by selecting the control level of the matrix coefficient, but from the viewpoint of music reproduction, it is adjusted to the optimum level for audibility. This circuit is controlled by using a phase discriminator that detects the phase of the input signal. A 2Ω-4Ωconversion encoder circuit is included as a synthesizer function, and special processing is applied to the reproduction of the normal 2Ω-channel source so that the QS Barrio matrix circuit can be effectively converted into 4Ωchannels. Also, by adding a phase matrix circuit, SANSUI's original front / back logic is realized, and the 4Ω-channel source created by SQ method can be reproduced with sufficient separation. It has a 4Ω-channel aux input terminal that can be used with 4Ω-channel tape decks or CD-4Ω.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a pure complimentary service circuit directly connected to all stages. The protective circuit is equipped with a quick-cut fuse and a relay to prevent pop noise during power ON/OFF.

EQUALIZER
A 2Ω-stage direct-coupled NF-type equalizer circuit is used for the preamplifier section. In addition, the tone control is a click step type, and the front and rear can be controlled independently.

FRONT END
For the front end of the tuner section, a dual gate MOS type FET and a precision four series varicon are adopted. The IF stage combines two stages of two element ceramic filters and an IC, and the multiplex circuit is also designed to improve stability by carefully selecting parts.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer, large capacitor, and NF-type constant voltage circuit. Equipped with functions such as low / high filter, loudness and balance control. Equipped with FM input sensitivity change-over switch. LOC is used for short distances with strong signals, and DIST is used for long distances. Equipped with a muting switch, noise between stations of FM broadcasting can be reduced. Volume and balance can be controlled from a remote location by using the optional remote controller."

name: DA-ALPHA607ΩI
description:
## Description

"D/A converter that employs balanced output and 8Ωx oversampling. It is equipped with a multi-auto-sampling system that automatically responds to 32Ωkhz, 44Ω.1Ωkhz and 48Ωkhz sampling frequencies. All digital sources can be reproduced by simply switching the input selector. The input sampling frequency is displayed on the front panel. The digital filter uses an 8Ωx oversampling digital filter. This increases the resolution eight times in the time axis direction and reduces the load on the analog filter. This eight times oversampling digital filter improves the filter characteristics with a passband ripple within ¥0Ω.0001ΩdB and a reduction of -100ΩdB or more outside the audio signal band. The analog filter has a wide bandwidth corresponding to a sampling frequency of 48ΩkHz, and uses a third order GIC type that only allows audio signals to pass through a resistor. The D/A converter is equipped with a high-precision ladder type D/A converter capable of high-speed serial data processing to eliminate the glitch (noise) that accompanies D/A conversion. By adopting a twin configuration in which the left and right D/A converters are used independently, the phase difference and crosstalk between the left and right channels are reduced and superior sound quality is achieved. In addition, a cross fine circuit is adopted to suppress 0Ωcross distortion, and low distortion rate and high SN are obtained. The power transformer is mounted on the rear panel to eliminate the influence of electromagnetic noise and vibration generated by the transformer on the signal system. name: A-ALPHA7Ω
description:
## Description

"This is an integrated amplifier of the Alf series that compactly condenses the technology of the AU - � series. In A - ¥7Ω, a combination of a diamond differential circuit and a Uilson current mirror circuit is generically called an advanced diamond differential circuit. By installing a diamond differential circuit in the power amplifier, the last stage power transistor (LAPT) can be driven with a sufficient margin, and the rise characteristic of the signal is improved, so that it can be used even in the rapidly changing digital source.

POWER AMPLIFIER
A Uilson current mirror circuit is used in the first stage of the power amplifier to suppress the circuit noise generated in the first stage and improve the quality of the amplifier as a whole. The diamond differential circuit has a structure in which four transistors are operated symmetrically with each other to obtain a powerful current. This is a high-speed and high-current response circuit unique to SANSUI. By adopting this circuit in the pre-drive stage, instantaneous current supply capability to the driver stage and final output stage is improved. By adding a Uilson current mirror circuit to the input differential amplifier circuit, the current flowing through the two amplifying elements can be made equal. By using this circuit in the first stage of the power amplifier, the current flowing through the amplifying element is always kept constant, and noise caused by temperature change or asymmetry of elements is suppressed. The twin monaural power unit configuration improves the separation between L and R, reduces crosstalk, and eliminates the mutual interference between L and R. In addition, insulators and side panels with excellent vibration damping characteristics prevent deterioration of sound quality. The output transistor uses LAPT (Linear Amplification Power Transistor) to improve the high-frequency stretch and response to sound.

POWER SUPPLY
The power transformer is equipped with a dedicated heavy-class EI transformer from Shinkai, which has gentle saturation and is suitable for obtaining strong sound quality. New improvements have been made to the electrolytic capacitor to achieve high sound quality. By using a newly developed acoustic conversion coating, defects inside the film have been reduced by 30Ω% compared with conventional ones. In addition, by using the new chemical conversion method, carbon content in the electrolytic solution has been reduced by 32Ω% compared with conventional ones. In addition, we have developed and adopted an electrolytic solution with less impurities. Rotary 6Ω-input input selector is used. Equipped with a CD direct mechanism, the transmission path of CD can be minimized and input directly to the power amplifier. Equipped with 3Ω-mode presence control function, volume balance can be adjusted according to listening condition or combination of speakers. It uses a screw-type gold-plated speaker terminal that is compatible with banana plugs. Gold plated terminals are used for all input and output terminals. It has a processor jack that can be connected to a surround processor or an equalizer. A 32Ω-key remote controller with CD, DECK and TUNER control is included."

name: A-ALPHA9Ω
description:
## Description

"This is an integrated amplifier that seeks sound quality equivalent to a full-size component by introducing as much technology as possible in this size. The A - ¥9Ωis equipped with the NEW Advanced Diamond differential circuit which realizes more excellent constant current effect and noise removal effect by adding FET elements to the Uilson current mirror constant current circuit. The advanced diamond differential circuit is a combination of a diamond differential circuit and a Uilson current mirror circuit. The diamond differential circuit has a structure in which four transistors operate symmetrically with each other to obtain a powerful current. This is a high-speed and high-current response circuit unique to SANSUI. By adopting this circuit in the pre-drive stage, the instantaneous current supply capability to the driver stage and final output stage is improved. Also, by adding a Uilson current mirror circuit to the input differential amplifier circuit, the current flowing through the two amplifier elements can be made equal. By adopting this circuit in the first stage of the power amplifier, the current flowing through the amplifier element is always kept constant, and noise caused by temperature change or asymmetry of elements is suppressed. By using the Advanced Diamond differential input circuit in the first stage, the FET differential amplifier in the input stage can be operated in an ideal manner. In addition, the circuit noise caused by temperature changes and element asymmetry is completely eliminated. The output transistor uses LAPT (Linear Amplification Power Transistor) to improve the high-frequency stretch and response to sound. Equipped with CD direct function. With this function, the transmission circuit of the music signal is shortened to realize purer CD playback, and it is directly connected to the power amplifier. In addition, a relay switching method is adopted to prevent signal degradation due to contact. Twin monaural construction is used for internal construction.

POWER AMPLIFIER
In this mechanism, the circuit board and radiator of the power amplifier, which consists of an advanced diamond differential circuit and LAPT, are integrated into L/R channels as completely independent units, eliminating interference between the left and right channels. In order to eliminate various vibrations and resonance given to the circuit from inside and outside of the amplifier, pure copper isolation parts are adopted between the transformer and radiator, which are vibration sources, and chassis, and the transmission path of vibration is cut off. In addition to the excellent vibration absorption capability of pure copper material, it has the advantage of being able to unify the tone and tone. Copper plated rear panel and copper plated screws are used for the rear panel to receive input / output terminals and speaker terminals in order to suppress mutual interference between connected devices. Side panel made of extruded aluminum is equipped as standard. As the weight increases due to the mounting of the side panel, high damping performance is obtained against internal vibration and low-frequency vibration from the outside. Gold-plated screws are used for mounting to the body. Starget electrolytic capacitors are used as electrolytic capacitors. This capacitor uses a newly developed acoustic chemical conversion coating that reduces the defects inside the film by 30Ω% compared with conventional capacitors, and the new chemical conversion method reduces the amount of carbon contained in the electrolyte by 32Ω% compared with conventional capacitors. In addition, we have achieved high response by developing an electrolyte with less impurities.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a heavyweight EI core transformer. The power unit uses many audio-only parts such as Starget electrolytic capacitors. The power cable uses an extremely thick power cable with polarity display equivalent to the AU - � series. Uses a screw-type gold-plated speaker terminal that supports banana plugs. name: AU-111ΩVINTAGE1999Ω
description:
## Description

"This is a pre-main amplifier that restored the original attractiveness in 1999Ω, 34Ωyears after the AU 111Ω, which was developed as the last vacuum tube amplifier of Sansui by gathering all of the technologies. Although the naming is different, in order to retain the charm of the original model, the front panel has inherited the same AU 111Ωlogo as it was at that time. We re-examine it from the point of view at the time of re-printing in order to correspond to the latest source.

POWER SUPPLY
Based on the specifications of the output transformer at that time and the engineers involved in its design and manufacturing, we restored and adopted the SW (Super Wide) type output transformer with large capacity output (guaranteed 30ΩHz/50ΩW continuous output), low loss (0Ω.25ΩdB or less), ultra-wide range (20ΩHz to 100ΩkHz), and NFB margin (25ΩdB). Since it uses a complicated winding structure, each piece is finished by hand by skilled engineers. The power tube, which is the key device, uses the Svetlana brand as a result of repeated testing of 6ΩL6ΩGC power tubes obtained from all over the world. It is operated by 6ΩL6ΩGC push-pull with AB, P. P. fixed bias. The circuit configuration of the power amplifier provides sufficient open-loop gain and uses a leak Mulard type that is easy to adjust AC balance. The first stage uses 6ΩAQ8Ω, which has high instantaneous power and can operate at high current, and the phase inversion uses 12ΩBH7ΩA, and the S/N of the auditory sense is obtained. The control amplifier uses a 12ΩAX7Ω4Ω-stage amplifier circuit including the cathode follower. All of the control amplifiers are 2Ω-stage amplified NF amplifiers, and a low-impedance output preamp can be used independently.

EQUALIZER
For analog record playback, the phono equalizer is a 2Ω-stage amplified NFB configuration of 12ΩAX7Ω, and it is compatible with MM cartridge with perfect shift. In addition, the MC cartridge has a separately sold A-603ΩS type input transformer in the MT9ΩP socket. The internal wiring is completely hand-made direct wiring without using any boards as it was at that time, and the sound quality change caused by using boards is cleared.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a large and large-capacity type power transformer that SUNSUI specializes in excellent regulation. It draws 480Ωv high voltage by double-voltage current and supplies it to the 6ΩL6ΩGC plate. Since the screen grid has large voltage fluctuations and cannot obtain stable high power, a Blater resistor is installed to stabilize it and enable large output. Also, you can enjoy the change of sound quality by using the detachable power cable. In addition to the low / high filter of the CR feedback system, it is equipped with an accessory circuit such as a loudness control, a presence control to improve articulation in the low frequency range, and a tape monitor. To support digital sources such as SACD and DVD-Audio, it is equipped with Route 6Ωinput via all-gold-plated input jacks. Uses a gold plated terminal corresponding to speaker impedance of 6Ω� ~ 8Ω� and 16Ω�. The main chassis is made of stainless steel for sound quality and long-term use. The oil condenser (No PCB), carbon resistance, and vacuum tube socket are used as parts to keep the original tone. In particular, oil condensers used for couplings have a significant effect on sound quality, so oil condensers are installed in all couplings as they were in those days.* The following are supplementary items included in the catalog. In order to make the most of its capabilities, SANSUI recommended a combination of speakers such as WestCoast speakers (ALTEC and JBL), coaxial speakers (TANNOY), and BBC monitor speakers (spendor). Repeated ON/OFF of the power switch is prohibited. When turning the power off, wait at least 30Ωseconds before turning the power on. If you turn on the power immediately, a large current will flow and damage the vacuum tube."

description:
## Description

"This is a top-of-the-line pre-main amplifier made by SANSUI using the best circuit technology based on selected parts. By using well-vetted components and expertise, the OCL pure complimentary service circuit for all stages is stable, and by using a parallel push-pull circuit with high output and low distortion rate, the total harmonic distortion rate, intermodulation distortion rate, and power distortion are guaranteed to be less than 0Ω.1Ω% from 5Ωhz to 40Ωkhz with sufficient margin from small output to large output.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a large power transformer and a large capacitor of 4Ωx4Ω,700ΩÏ‰ F. In addition to supplying power to the power stage independently for each channel, a + - 2Ωpower supply system has been adopted to improve stability and enable the power transistor to be driven with allowance. In addition, the power stage and pre-drive stage are provided with separate power supplies, and the pre-drive stage is driven at a higher voltage than the power stage, thus enabling stable driving without being affected by load fluctuations. A parallel push circuit that can reduce the collector current of the power transistor to 1Ω/2Ωof the conventional one. In this circuit, only the part with good current characteristics of the transistor can be selected. This circuit, combined with the all-stage direct connection OCL pure complimentary service circuit, can suppress distortion and obtain stable high output. In addition, the differential amplifier, which influences the stability of all stages directly connected, is composed of two stages by a combination of low-noise transistors, and it is designed to perform ideal parallel push-pull operation by constant-current driving. We place importance on the phase margin, which is considered as one means of measuring amplifier stability.

EQUALIZER
Reliability under all load conditions from the equalizer section to the main section is considered by taking not only the ultra-low section but also the ultra-high section as large enough. As a result, it has a broad spectrum distribution for the fundamental wave, exhibits a characteristic response even to a pulsed music signal, and enables stable operation and high-quality sound.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer circuit is a 3Ω-stage PNP-NPN-PNP direct-coupled equalizer circuit. Moreover, the maximum allowable input is 300ΩmV due to the high voltage supplied from the stable constant voltage power supply. In addition, the RIAA deviation, which affects sound quality, is guaranteed to be ¥0Ω.5ΩdB at 30ΩHz to 15ΩkHz by using a low-noise transistor, low-error resistor, and capacitor in the RIAA element. Click noise generated during switch switching is solved by using - power supply and setting the base potential of the first stage to 0Ω. To protect the transistor, a current limiter circuit is built in to limit the collector current of the output stage and driver stage so that it does not flow more than a certain value when overloaded. A relay combined with an electronic circuit and a short-cut fuse protects the power transistor and speaker in the event of an error. The relay circuit also functions as an audio mute, so there is no unpleasant pop noise when the power is turned on. Uses T. T. C. (Triple Tone Control) of only SANSUI that can obtain an ideal curve of ¥15Ωdb in 3Ωdb steps for low and high sound, and ¥5Ωdb in 1Ωdb steps for medium sound only. The T. T. C. amplifier uses a low-noise FET to ensure high input impedance at the first stage, and is an NF type with 3Ω-stage and 2Ω-stage direct-coupled circuits. With a tone selector circuit, the sound quality can be adjusted in a total of nine stages : low 150ΩHz, 300ΩHz and 600ΩHz, high 6ΩkHz, 3Ω.5ΩkHz and 2ΩkHz as rising and falling points, and middle 750ΩHz, 1Ω.5ΩkHz and 3ΩkHz as the center. It is designed with a defeat switch so that each T. T. C. circuit can be defeated and flat characteristics can be obtained. It adopts a 12ΩdB/oct NF type dedicated active filter circuit system, and the cutoff frequency can be switched between 12Ωkhz and 6Ωkhz for the high filter and 25Ωhz and 50Ωhz for the low filter. There is no variation in the frequency response in the middle range. There are two tape monitoring circuits that allow recording and playback monitoring on either of two tape decks connected simultaneously. The tape reprint switch allows you to freely reprint tapes from either tape deck and monitor them while they are being reprinted. Moreover, you can enjoy recording and FM from the speaker as usual while reprinting. A 4Ω-channel stereo system can be configured by connecting a 4Ω-channel adapter. When a 4Ω-ch adapter is not used, recording and playback monitoring can be performed by connecting a tape deck. Tape reprints are also available from a tape deck connected to a tape monitor circuit. By connecting an N. R. (noise reduction) adapter, you can reduce tape hiss and record Hi-Fi on two connected tape decks simultaneously. Playback can be performed on either tape deck by switching the tape monitor switch. The speaker jacks are installed in the Route 3Ωof A, B and C. You can switch between A + B and A + C by using the speaker switch. Two phono inputs are installed. Phono1Ωis designed to switch the input impedance between 50Ωk ¥, and Phono2Ωis designed to switch the input impedance between 30Ωk ¥, 50Ωk ¥, and 100Ωk � depending on the cartridge. The preamplifier section and main amplifier section can be used independently by removing the connectors on the back panel. It is equipped with a muting switch that can attenuate all of the range by 20ΩdB without using volume. The Deck1Ω, 2Ω, and AUX have level adjusters that allow you to unify the input levels and eliminate the need to set the volume at each selector switch. High impedance type microphones can be connected separately on the left and right. Equipped with DIN connector for easy connection of tape deck. Equipped with 5Ωposition mode selectors : Stereo Reverse, Normal, Mono, L + R, L, R. It is equipped with a loudness circuit. It is equipped with 2Ωheadphone jacks, and one of them is designed to turn off the speaker automatically when you plug in the headphone. Equipped with 2Ωgrounding terminals. It has 4ΩAC outlets, Switchedx2Ωand Unswitchedx2Ω. All the knobs are made of pure aluminum."

description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier has improved audio characteristics and operability by adopting a unique chassis structure. The AU 9900Ωhas a partitioned layout with the preamplifier and tone control located on the front panel side, and the power and power supplies such as heat sinker and power transistor located on the rear side. As a result, each function and operation are integrated into a single pre-main amplifier an independent state, reducing mutual interference. The input terminals for players and other devices are installed on the front right side panel, and the output terminals for speakers are installed on the left side panel, so that the signal flow can be smoothly amplified along the shortest path. In addition, the input terminal, selector switch and equalizer amplifier are close to each other, reducing the shielding wire and preventing the degradation of high-frequency characteristics due to stray capacitance.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section uses a fully connected pure complimentary service OCL system with a differential-amplifier circuit at the input stage.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The output stage employs a parallel push-pull circuit that provides sufficient power at a low distortion rate.

EQUALIZER

The RIAA correction is a CR + NF type that independently performs high-pass and low-pass operations, and provides more accurate RIAA and phase characteristics. Equipped with triple tone control that allows mid-range control in addition to normal tone control. The tone selector switches the turnover frequency between three low and three high levels. A highly regulated and efficient toroidal transformer is used for the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
A large capacity capacitor and a stabilized power supply circuit are combined to supply a stable � power supply to each block stage. Temperature detection, DC detection and ASO detection current limiter circuit is adopted for the protection circuit to protect the speaker and power transistor. Equipped with a tone defeat switch that passes through the tone circuit and provides a flat frequency response. The volume level can be set to 0ΩdB, -10ΩdB or -20ΩdB. Equipped with a 2Ω-circuit tape play circuit, tape copy switch, tuner priority selector, low / high filter, muting switch, input impedance and sensitivity selector switch."

name: AU-D7Ω
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier using a diamond differential circuit and newly developed linear A circuit. Equipped with the diamond differential circuit adopted in the AU-D series. This circuit is an ideal circuit that can instantaneously supply a large amount of drive current to the power stage for any input. The TIM (Transient Intermodulation Distortion), which is the most harmful dynamic distortion for music playback, is as close to 0Ωas possible. As a result, the AU-D7Ωachieves a slew rate of ¥120ΩV / Ï‰ sec (inside slew rate ¥220ΩV / Ï‰ sec), which is twice as fast as conventional same class amplifiers.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The power amplifier section is composed of a DC amplifier, and the newly developed linear A circuit is used for the amplification method to achieve both A-class sound quality and B-class efficiency. In this method, the bias of the output stage is controlled in real time so that it does not cut off in response to the input signal. In principle, there is no switching distortion or crossover distortion, and at the same time, high efficiency comparable to that of B-class is obtained. A non-magnetic (NM) power transistor is used as the power transistor element. The circuit is composed of two amplifiers without a flat amplifier, and the MC output is also directly input to the equalizer, making it simple and straight.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer amplifier section consists of 10Ωtransistors with cascode connection of FET differential input. By changing the gain, the optimum amplification degree is obtained for both MM cartridge and MC cartridge. The tone control section uses four cross-band tone control that two common high and low tones, plus medium and ultra low tones. name: AU-D55ΩF
description:
## Description

"Pre-main amplifier with super FF (feed-forward) system. The Super FF system is an original system adopted in the AU-F Extra series, and is a technology that was born by combining the feedforward theory invented by Dr. H. S. Black with NFB. The NFB is primarily responsible for reducing distortion in the audible band and also for extracting anti-phase distortion for feed-forward. As a result, the NFB is dominant in the audible band and the feed-forward is dominant outside the audible band to cancel distortion. This theoretically reduces any distortion that occurs in the power stage. This system consists of an error collection amplifier for amplifying the distortion cancellation signal and a symmetrical two pole output summing network utilizing the latest computer technology.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The Super FF system is adopted in the power amplifier section, and all stages are composed of differential amplification DC amplifiers. Low-noise FET is used for the first stage and cascode bootstrap connection is used for the third stage.

POWER SUPPLY
In the power supply section, we have developed and adopted a dual-bridge method that enhances the power supply by increasing the energy utilization factor. Compared with the conventional method, which uses two positive and two negative diodes for rectification, the dual-bridge method uses four diodes for each, improving the rectification effect by 30Ω%. In addition, since there is no ground at the midpoint of the power transformer and the ground point is isolated from the chassis via a diode, no stray current flows into the chassis more than necessary and does not adversely affect the signal ground point. In addition, a one point grounding system has been adopted for all grounding systems, and the LED circuit and protector circuit are independent power sources to improve sound quality.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer amplifier section uses a high-precision equalizer with an emphasis on disc quality. As a result, the frequency characteristics have been expanded to 100ΩkHz and high SN and low distortion have been achieved. In addition, an MC/MM compatible equalizer is used that supports MC and MM by changing the gain. In addition, the built-in subsonic filter suppresses waviness and distortion in the ultra-low range caused by the warping of the record.

EQUALIZER
In addition to minimizing the signal path, the equalizer and power section are completely separated, and the pre-drive stage and power stage are separated by a large heat sink to promote the flux-free concept. A tone control circuit is incorporated into the NF circuit of the power section. It uses a direct access input selector that can select all inputs with one touch. The main volume is made of machined pure aluminum. Equipped with loudness and high filter."

name: AU-X1Ω
description:
## Description

"An amplifier designed to pursue the ideal that ""an amplifier must be a single conductor with an amplification degree that faithfully transmits music signals"" as far as possible. Approximately half of the space is the power supply.

EQUALIZER
All stages are independent on the left and right, power stage, pre-drive stage, flat amplifier / equalizer and MC head amplifier are all independent 8Ωpower supply configurations.

POWER SUPPLY
It is a 2Ω-transformer system consisting of a 600ΩVA large-capacity toroidal transformer and an 80ΩVI Ï‰ EI transformer. Custom large-capacity electrolytic capacitor 10Ω,000ΩÏ‰ Fx8Ωdeveloped exclusively for audio is connected in parallel. A 1Ω.2Ωmm thick copper plate is used in the ground circuit. Therefore, even if the speaker impedance changes with frequency, stable operation is achieved by the powerful power supply. Equipped with a diamond differential circuit and newly developed linear high-speed output device NM-LAPT (Non Magnetic-Linear Amp. Power Transistor), we succeeded in reducing TIM distortion and envelope distortion, which are dynamic distortions that interfere with sound quality, to as close to 0Ωas possible. From large die-cast heat sinker to high-efficiency triple-braided speaker cable wiring, each part is selected based on a reliable characteristic check and hearing. The power amplifier operation switch on the front panel can be used to separate pre-power and power.

POWER SUPPLY
Power is supplied to the power stage using two windings with independent left and right channels and a large toroidal transformer (power supply capacity 600Ωva) with good regulation by two rectifier circuits. In addition, a custom large-capacity electrolytic capacitor 10Ω,000ΩÏ‰ Fx8Ωdeveloped exclusively for audio is connected in parallel, and a 1Ω.2Ωmm thick copper plate is used for the ground circuit.

POWER SUPPLY
The pre-drive stage uses a large EI transformer (80ΩVA power supply capacity) with two independent power supplies for both left and right channels to powerfully drive the diamond differential circuit.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer amplifier and flat amplifier are supplied from independent constant-voltage circuits on the left and right sides, and the MC head amplifier is supplied from independent low-voltage circuits on the left and right sides with separate windings. The newly developed NM-LAPT with high breakdown strength and cut-off frequency (ft100ΩMHz) as a power transistor with high speed and excellent linearity is made into a triple push-pull connection, and is used at an operating point with excellent linearity.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The head amplifier section is a DC amplifier configuration that further advances symmetrical push-pull input / output using newly developed low-noise, high-gmP-ch and N-ch FET. The first stage is a direct-coupled push-pull input in which a large number of low-noise, high-gmP-ch and N-ch FETs are connected in parallel, realizing ideal input impedance and high S/N ratio. The second stage is an MC amplifier circuit with excellent linearity and excellent open-loop characteristics due to a push-pull drive double-stage direct connection circuit using a combination of NPN-PNP transistors. In addition, extremely stable operation is obtained by supplying power exclusively for MC and independently for the left and right.

EQUALIZER
POWER AMPLIFIER
The equalizer amplifier section consists of a direct-coupled DC amplifier with a diamond differential circuit. The first stage has good pair characteristics, low-noise, high-gm, differential input circuit using dual FET, and cascode bootstrap circuit which is not affected by input impedance. In addition, the high-performance constant current circuit (PAT. PEND) composed of a 2Ω-stage direct-coupled circuit composed of NPN-PNP transistor combination provides high CMRR (in-phase component suppression cost) at the summing point and excellent dynamic characteristics.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The second and third stages are diamond differential circuit + current differential push-pull with excellent drive capability, and the output stage is SEPP circuit with Darlington connection, which has sufficient current margin. The low-output impedance and low-impedance NF circuit design provides sufficient dynamic range even against changes in load impedance, and S/N ratio is improved.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The flat amplifier adopts a push-pull drive DC amplifier configuration with a differential input circuit using newly developed 1ΩTip (4Ωelements enclosed) FET in the first stage, and achieves excellent operation by independent power supply on the left and right. name: AU-X11Ω
description:
## Description

"This master integrated DC amplifier was developed in pursuit of the ideal form of i-Integrated Amplifier and by putting all sound technologies into it. Super FF & diamond differential circuit is adopted for the power stage. The Super FF system is a combination of NFB and feed-forward, and theoretically cancels any distortion generated in the power stage. The structure of this system is that the distortion is reduced by NFB, and the distortion component is extracted after the pre-drive stage by its distortion component detection function. The distortion cancellation signal is amplified by the error collection amplifier forming the feed-forward circuit in the same way as the red signal circuit, and the two signals are synthesized at the output. In addition, the summing point is matched by the adoption of accurate and stable summing network. The diamond differential circuit has a structure in which transistors are arranged in the shape of a diamond, and the current margin of the drive stage can be made infinitely large to realize the high-speed response of the drive stage.

EQUALIZER
The equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise, high-gm dual FET and a diamond differential circuit to enhance sound quality.

MOTOR
In addition, a DC servo configuration is adopted.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The MC head amplifier section adopts a DC amplifier configuration of single-channel 14Ω-stone FET and push-pull input / output power supply system exclusively for left and right sides.

POWER SUPPLY
In the power supply section, a large toroidal transformer for the power amplifier stage and a large EI transformer for the voltage amplifier stage are adopted. There are eight power supplies, power stage, pre-drive stage, flat amplifier / equalizer, and MC head amplifier completely independent on the left and right sides. All copper plated chassis, NM elements, wood bonnet and copper plated screws are flux-free."

name: AU-X111ΩMOSVINTAGE
description:
## Description

"Based on the circuit technology and know-how up to that time, this pre-main amplifier was developed through uncompromising selection of parts, improvement and hearing test. While applying the know-how accumulated in the development of the C-2301Ωand B-2301ΩL Separate Amplifiers, we have implemented thorough anti-vibration design, deadening, and electromagnetic wave splash prevention measures. In addition, we have developed custom-made parts and used proven parts. A MOS FET is used as the power element. Four parallel push-pull elements are used at four locations on the left and right sides of the power stage and plus / minus sides, for a total of 16Ωelements. This enhances the low-impedance drive capability and provides a highly stable drive. In addition, hum and noise components are canceled by balance transmission and amplification, and the ground is separated from the - side so that it is not affected by the ground. Therefore, it is resistant to noise interference and hum from the outside, and the SN ratio and transparency of the auditory sense are improved.

POWER SUPPLY
In order to prevent AC lines contaminated with clock pulses and phase control noise from home appliances and microcomputers, the power supply circuit is a balanced power supply configuration with a closed loop regardless of the ground color, similar to the amplifier circuit. In order to be compatible with video equipment, an input terminal for video is mounted. In order to prevent the high-frequency components of video signals from adversely affecting sound quality, the video signals are not wired in the chassis at all. Instead, they are processed by IC switches on the back of the rear panel pin jack. The power for the IC is supplied from a transformer other than the audio system. This completely eliminates both physical and electrical power. In addition, the IC switch itself has a passband of 10ΩMHz to prevent image quality degradation. It is compact and high-performance with that can be said to be equipped with two monaural amplifiers, and is compact and high-performance. It is equipped with the Power Direct function. When this function is ON, all operations of the pre-section and control section are shut off and the signal from the dedicated input terminal is amplified. In addition, in order to adjust the volume even in this case, it is equipped with an independent volume for the left and right. In order to improve the operation feeling, we have adopted a slightly pleasant switch click, a knob made of unpolished aluminum, a side panel made of extruded aluminum, a shower light that illuminates switches, etc. The speaker switches are installed Route 3Ω, with large speaker jacks and canon-type jacks. The front panel can be used to separate the PRE and MAIN sections, the left and right independent power amplifier input levels are provided, and the Route 3Ωpower amplifier / direct input is provided. It is equipped with functions such as REC selector with Off position, balance control and headphone port."

name: AU-X1111ΩMOSVINTAGE
description:
## Description

"This is the last amplifier in the X series that started with AU-X1Ω. Earth-based amplifiers drive the speakers between the output of the amplifier and the ground, so they are susceptible to noise and distortion from the ground, which degrade sound quality. In order to solve this problem, we have adopted a balanced circuit that is not grounded. In this circuit, the - side of the speaker is double-push-pull driven in both directions under the same conditions as the + side. This eliminates unnecessary high-frequency components such as noise and distortion, and realizes an excellent sound image at a low distortion rate. In addition, there is no noise from the power supply and no IHM (Interface Hum Modulation) caused by back electromotive force from the speakers. It also supports changes in the impedance and phase of speakers.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply circuit that operates the balanced circuit is also a closed loop with no connection to the ground circuit. In addition, we have achieved low impedance and high speed in the entire power supply by adopting a newly developed heavy-duty transformer that has been carefully examined from the viewpoints of sound quality and electrical performance without simply pursuing a sense of weight. We have also examined various aspects from capacity to core material and winding material. We have also selected custom-made electrolytic capacitors for audio and fast recovery diodes. In order to prevent noise from connected digital devices, we do not insert a line filter.

POWER SUPPLY
Instead, we use a unique balance transmission method from the signal circuit including the power stage to the power supply circuit. In the signal path, the + side and the - side are transmitted in a balanced manner so that hum and noise components can be canceled. Moreover, the ground is separated from the - side so that it is not affected by hum and noise components. As a result, the S / N ratio and transparency of the sound are improved. The twin monaural construction is based on the concept of a separate power amplifier.

POWER SUPPLY
POWER AMPLIFIER
The power supply section centered on a large power transformer is placed in the center, and the power amplifier section mounted on the heat sinker is separated symmetrically. This effectively improves crosstalk between L/R units and interference between power supply system vibration and music signal. In addition, the master volume and the left and right volumes are completely independent. In addition to improving the shielding characteristics between stages and eliminating mutual interference of signals, the effects of external digital electromagnetic noise and magnetic distortion are also eliminated. The power MOS FET, power transformer and master volume are mounted on a pure copper plate. The bottom plate is shielded by copper plating. A large insulator made of pure copper muku covered with felt is also used to reduce the influence of the ground surface on sound quality. Thus, detailed measures against vibration are taken. A total of 16ΩMOS FETs are used in the diamond power stage, and four double-push-pull FETs are used in four places on the left, right and + - sides of the power stage. It is equipped with an image input terminal is compatible with switching and dubbing of images when a VTR is connected. To cope with the problem that high-frequency components of video signals adversely affect sound quality, the video signals are processed by IC switches on the back of the pin jacks on the rear panel without any wiring inside the chassis. In addition, the power for the IC is supplied from a transformer separate from the audio system, and a single ON/OFF switch is provided. Thus, the cross point between the audio and video signals is completely separated physically and electrically. In order to pursue the real quality of design, wood panels made of real rosewood are used on both sides and the top. In addition, front glass panel and shower light are used. Equipped with a presence control function that slightly raises the middle and low band energy without changing the tone even when playing back at a low volume. Front panel can be used to separate the front and main parts. Equipped with left and right independent power amplifier input levels."

name: TU-D607Ω
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner equipped with newly developed digital quartz system and improved reception system. Equipped with SANSUI's original newly developed digital quartz lock system. In this system, the receiving frequency is locked every 100ΩkHz with reference to the crystal oscillator. Even if an error occurs in the local oscillation frequency, the D/A converter generates a feedback voltage proportional to the error in the output, and the receiving frequency is maintained at the high accuracy of the crystal oscillation. With this method, the reception frequency is digitally processed, so spurious interference and SN ratio degradation that adversely affect sound quality and reception performance are minimized, and other circuits and specifications are hardly affected. Thus, excellent sound quality is achieved. Moreover, the lock width is sufficiently large, and the frequency is accurately digitally displayed, making tuning operation easy. In addition, since the automatic lock ON-OFF circuit is built in, it is possible to keep the locked state even if the tuning part is touched. A low-noise dual-gate MOS FET is used for the high-frequency stage. In combination with a wide-gap precision frequency linear 4Ωseries varicon, the sensitivity and interference rejection capability are improved. The FM IF section uses a differential amplifier circuit consisting of three ICs, including a Darlington differential IC, to obtain sufficient amplification and limiter characteristics. A newly developed linear-phase Ceremic filter and a Darlington differential IC are used to flatten the delay characteristics regardless of the level change of the input radio wave and improve various characteristics. A PLL MPX circuit with a built-in pilot canceler is used to prevent the pilot signal that divides the FM stereo broadcast transmission into L and R from damaging the music signal. The reception frequency of AM waves is also displayed digitally. The AM monolithic IC realizes high sensitivity and high stability, and the AM IF section incorporates an LC block filter with good selectivity characteristics to realize good reception regardless of signal strength.

POWER AMPLIFIER
The audio section uses a DC amplifier configuration that reflects the wide-range concept. By thoroughly comparing the TIM distortion and frequency characteristics, the power source impedance is expanded from the low band to the ultra high band, and sound quality with power and good balance is realized.

POWER SUPPLY
An error amplification type constant voltage power supply circuit is adopted to provide a stable power supply to each circuit. In addition, in order to prevent the adverse effect of the power supply on sound quality, low impedance has been developed to obtain high separation up to ultra-high frequencies and to improve accurate sound image localization and sound graining. An FM muting circuit is employed to cut out the inter-station noise that is unique to FM broadcasting, and the harsh inter-station noise is cut sharply to ensure high quality. Equipped with a noise canceler switch, output level adjustable terminal, 300Ω� / 75Ω� coaxial antenna terminal for FM, and high-sensitivity flexible AM bar antenna."

name: TU-S707ΩX
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner equipped with SLDD (Super Linear Digital Decoder). The demodulation circuit is equipped with SANSUI's original SLDD, which combines the advantages of the square-wave switching demodulation method and the sinusoidal demodulation method. By digital processing using the Wallisch function sequence, this circuit completely shuts out unwanted harmonic distortion caused by noise, Birdie intermodulation, and neighboring station interference, which had to be removed by the conventional anti-RF filter. This eliminates adverse effects such as phase difference and degradation of separation caused by the anti-RF filter., by eliminating the unwanted harmonic distortion caused by the anti-RF filter. Birdie intermodulation and noise interference.

FRONT END
A front end equivalent to 5Ωseries using twin varicap diodes is adopted for the front end. A dual-gate MOS FET is used in the RF stage and mixer section to improve linearity, SN ratio and distortion factor, and to secure dynamic range for strong input. In addition, by setting the total gain moderately, it is possible to operate with plenty of margin. The TU-S707ΩX quartz synthesizer employs a pulse swallow method. By setting the reference frequency generated by the quartz to 25ΩkHz, which is outside the audible band, the SN ratio is improved without loss of reception capability. Equipped with an IF band switching function. Conventional tuners have a problem that they are susceptible to interference from neighboring stations when the tuner is wide. However, TU-S707ΩX uses SLDD to solve this problem. Since no harmonics are generated in the demodulation process, no noise is generated by neighboring stations even when the tuner is wide. Narrow position is used as a countermeasure against interference in a limited area. Both FM and AM antennas are balanced by a floating circuit system with separate GND. The floating circuit system shuts out common-mode noise caused by the ground potential difference between the chassis and the system, resulting in a good signal-to-noise ratio in actual use.

POWER SUPPLY
Semiconductor ceramic capacitors are used in high-frequency circuits to achieve low distortion and high S/N s / N. We also use fast recovery diodes and high-performance capacitors for the power supply.

MOTOR
A static drive system is adopted in which the FL frequency tube is separated from the signal line to improve the sound quality. A total of 16Ωpreset memories (8ΩFM and 8ΩAM) are installed. In addition, it is equipped with a preset scan function that monitors the stored program for approximately 4Ωseconds by pressing the switch. It is equipped with a memory backup function using a lithium battery and a large-capacity capacitor, and achieves memory of more than five years. To improve the S / N ratio of the AM tuner section, the antenna input and audio output are balanced and balanced. In addition, it is designed for high sensitivity, wide bandwidth and low noise. An FET buffer is used in the AM tuner section, and pre-emphasis AM broadcasting is also available by switching IF bands. Equipped with 440ΩHz, 0Ω.39ΩV REC calibration function. Equipped with RF MODE function to prevent front-end saturation at large input. Equipped with an FM noise canceller. Equipped with last one memory that automatically calls up the station when power is OFF. Equipped with AC cord with polarity display. There are 2Ωcolor variations, black and silver."

name: TU-S707ΩXDECADE
description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner equipped with SLDDII. It is equipped with SLDDII, a digital demodulation system unique to SANSUI. In this circuit, switching carriers themselves are made closer to sine waves, which do not have demodulation capability for unnecessary high frequencies. This eliminates anti-noise filters and correction circuits, which degrade sound quality, and improves Birdie and sound quality. Front end equivalent to 5Ωtrain is adopted. This circuit uses a twin varicap diode to improve the interference rejection capability at the inlet and to prevent tuning deviation and distortion. In addition, by using a dual-gate MOS FET in the RF stage and mixer section, linearity, SN ratio and distortion factor are improved, and dynamic range at strong input is ensured. Equipped with an IF band switching function. Conventional tuners have a problem that they are susceptible to interference from neighboring stations when the tuner is wide. However, in the TU-S707ΩX Decade, this problem is solved by the SLDDII. Since no harmonics are generated in the demodulation process, no noise is generated by neighboring stations even when the tuner is wide. Narrow position is used as a countermeasure against interference in a limited area. In order to eliminate noise from the FM antenna and speaker cable, both FM and AM antennas are balanced by a floating circuit system with a separate GND. This improves the high-frequency characteristics. A constant voltage circuit using a zener diode is used for the DC power supply. This reduces the drift and improves the stability of the circuit. description:
## Description

"Aiming for the highest level of control amplifier, this control amplifier is equipped with excellent basic performance and extensive adjustment functions. The EQ section uses a + -2Ωpower supply and a class A pure complimentary service push-pull system with a CR-NF type 2Ωamplifier configuration. This circuit emphasizes dynamic characteristics such as phase characteristics, dynamic range, and signal-to-noise ratio, while limiting correction of RIAA deviation, which affects sound quality, to ¥0Ω.2ΩdB. Compensation for RIAA deviation is generally performed with an NF-type circuit. However, with the CA 3000Ω, high-frequency compensation is performed with the CR-type and low-frequency compensation is performed with the NF-type, so there are no peaks or phase shifts that tend to occur in high-frequency ranges, and sound quality with a high SN ratio is achieved. This circuit is driven by a high voltage of + - 50ΩV supplied from a constant-voltage power supply independently on the left and right sides, and has a high maximum allowable input.

POWER SUPPLY
A toroidal transformer is used for the power supply section, and all stages are independently stabilized on the left and right sides to prevent interference between channels and blocks. The tone controls feature a unique triple tone control that adds a midrange to the normal bass / treble. The high and low turnover frequencies can be switched in three stages, and the tone amplifier can be passed by a defeat switch. The tone amplifier uses carefully selected low-noise transistors and high-precision CR elements. There is no increase in distortion component even when boosted, and sufficient amount of NF is applied. A wide dynamic range and high SN ratio are obtained. It is equipped with a level meter by logarithmic compression circuit. This level meter the dynamic range, output of dynamic range, output of the power amplifier, level matching with the deck, etc. with the changeover switch. The Phono input has a switching function that allows switching between three levels of impedance and three levels of input sensitivity. Also, the input capacity can be switched to 3Ωlevels. It uses a stepless precision volume with less interlocking and variation error comparable to an attenuator. name: C-2105ΩVINTAGE
description:
## Description

"Stereo control amplifier paired with B-2105Ω. The power supply board and line amplifier board are made of Teflon, which has extremely low dielectric constant and dissipation factor, maintains electrical flat frequency characteristics up to the GHz range, and has high mechanical vibration absorption. As a result, various types of interference from the surroundings are suppressed in order to prevent harmful vibration to the elements, loss of passing signal is prevented, and flux jumping and vibration are eliminated. The line amplifier is equipped with a MOS FET that can set the input impedance high and has excellent high-frequency characteristics. The second stage is a vertical differential system and has a simple circuit configuration with a Darlington output. The inverting amplifier has an inverted Darlington output and is mounted on a single channel. The circuit that requires a power supply is minimized and the balance output is and the balance output is also incorporated into the Teflon substrate to eliminate factors of sound quality degradation.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a newly designed transformer with low magnetic induction and excellent regulation.

POWER SUPPLY
The electrolytic capacitor and Teflon power supply board are separated into individual units and mounted floating on the power supply chassis. Equipped with a phono equalizer that supports three positions : MC, HIGH, MC, and MM. The input is a FET differential para-connected to achieve low impedance. The second stage is a vertical differential and is output by inverted Darlington. The left and right channels operate under the same conditions, and independent structures have been introduced to eliminate the effects of electrical and magnetic interference and vibration between units. In addition, the bottom plate made of pure copper, aluminum line amp base chassis, aluminum side panels, and copper-plated structures are made of non-magnetic materials, non-resonance, and noise prevention. In addition, a teflon sheet is used for the top plate to prevent internal reflection and vibration. The insulator is made of pure copper material with excellent damping properties and is gold-plated. Genuine leather is used for the installation part to reduce unnecessary internal and external vibrations. The connector is equipped with WBT's OFC alloy 24Ω-carat hardened gold plated RCA terminal. In addition, gold plated balanced input-output terminals made by Neutrik are mounted.6ΩN Teflon shield wire is used for the internal wiring material and each part is carefully selected."

name: C-2302ΩVINTAGE
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo control amplifier that combines the sophistication of Sansui's accumulated technologies with its history into a new dimension. The circuit, mechanism and parts are lavish, and each unit is hand-made with great care. All circuit boards use gold-plated Teflon boards. By taking advantage of the characteristics of Teflon that the dielectric constant and dissipation factor are extremely small and vibration is absorbed by internal loss, various interference from the surroundings to signals reaching ultra-high frequency range is suppressed.

EQUALIZER
POWER AMPLIFIER
Both the line and equalizer are simple A-class DC amplifier configuration, and the input and output stages are equipped with MOS FET which can set the input impedance high and has excellent high-frequency characteristics.

EQUALIZER
In addition, by using only a line and an equalizer as an amplifier and minimizing circuits that require a power supply, noise from the ground line and other factors that degrade the sound quality of the signal system are eliminated. The low impedance and wide range of the signal line make it possible to obtain excellent S / N ratio. In addition, to prevent contact loss of the selector inserted in the signal line, all switches are designed in parallel to enlarge and strengthen the contact surface. This reduces the contact impedance of the signal line and prevents the loss of the minute end of the audio signal. In order to realize more ideal balance operation, we have developed and adopted the same type of balance conversion transformer (output impedance 600Ω¥, 1Ω: 1Ωstep-up ratio) as that used in broadcasting stations. This realizes perfect uniformity of hot and cold characteristics, and improves stability and SN ratio.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply section uses a transformer with extremely low leakage flux and excellent regulation.

POWER SUPPLY
It is combined with a newly developed electrolytic capacitor for power supply, ultrafast fast recovery diode, and 6ΩN copper cable to form an excellent power supply section. The right and left channels are driven under the same conditions. In order to eliminate the effects of electrical and magnetic interference and vibration between channels, the unit shield case housing, bottom plate, and rear input plate surrounding the unit are made of pure copper. All other structures, including the screw, are plated with copper. This makes the structure non-magnetic, non-resonant, and prevents noise. In addition, Teflon sheet and pure copper plate are combined for the side wood and top plate to prevent internal reflection and vibration. The master volume consists of a high-grade detent type with improved durability and accuracy directly from a gold-plated substrate, a parallel configuration to reduce signal passing impedance, and a pure copper case to isolate it from the surroundings. In addition, the knob has a double structure that uses pure copper material inside and machined aluminum material outside to cut vibration transmission from the outside.8Ωmm thick solid aluminum plate is extruded and used for the front panel. Solid aluminum is used for the input selector and all of the accessory knobs.

POWER SUPPLY
All mounting parts of the power transformer, power circuit board, line amplifier, equalizer amplifier, etc. are equipped with newly developed supporters made of Teflon material. In addition to vibration isolation, we have succeeded in maintaining sound quality between each unit and each line. Various ideas have been put into fine parts such as screws to fix the panel. In particular, insulators are made of gold-plated pure copper material with special rubber inserted with a Teflon sheet. They are fixed to the body with gold-plated brass screws passed through Teflon supporters. The signal cable that connects the circuit to the input / output terminal uses an original 6ΩN copper shielded cable with low transmission loss manually wrapped Teflon tape. In addition, the connector is equipped with a gold-plated terminal made by WBT Germany, which has low impedance and high corrosion resistance. In addition, all parts through which music signals pass are gold-plated, non-magnetic, low-impedance, high-speed, and vibration-proof. We are working to achieve world-class combinations from signal entry to signal exit. For MC cartridges, exclusive MC transformers using imported core materials for both Low and High have been adopted from Shinkai, and a total of four transformers consisting of two independent left and right transformers has been realized."

description:
## Description

"Stereo preamplifier equipped with AM/FM tuner. The FM front end of the tuner section employs a 3Ω-row varicon and an FET in the RF stage to obtain high sensitivity and to improve the ability to eliminate interfering waves such as cross modulation and image rejection. In addition, the AGC circuit improves the selectivity in a strong electric field. The 4Ω-stage IF amplifier and 3Ω-stage limiter circuit provide sufficient limiter limiter effect make reception easy even in noise prone areas. Muting and Noise Canceler switches are 3Ω-stage switching systems, so you can enjoy noise-free broadcasting both when selecting channels and when receiving signals. Muting eliminates inter-station noise and allows quiet channel selection. The noise canceller eliminates the conventional high-cut method and eliminates noise when receiving FM broadcasts without cutting the high-frequency audible range.

POWER SUPPLY
The power supply for the FM front-end, FM and AM sections uses a stabilized Zener diode power supply. In particular, we have succeeded in eliminating the AFC circuit by safely compensating the temperature of the station generator with the front end and minimizing the station generator drift by stabilizing the power supply. Equipped with a sharp pinpoint tuning circuit. Equipped with 35Ωdb separation FM multi-circuit. Equipped with pure electronic FM stereo and mono switching. The FM antenna is equipped with two circuit impedance terminals of 300Ω� and 75Ω¥, and is equipped with a local / variable switch so that undistorted reception is possible even in high-field areas. The AM tuner section contains a high-sensitivity ferrite bar antenna. The preamplifier section consists of an NF amplifier for all amplifier circuits from the first stage to the final output stage.

EQUALIZER
A specially selected low-noise silicon transistor is used in the equalizer circuit, and an all-silicon transistor is used in the low-frequency section to reduce the S/N ratio. The tone control amplifier section is designed with attention to noise and distortion characteristics by using low-noise silicon transistors and NF-type tone control. It is equipped with a headphone jack separate booster independent of the output circuit, it can also be used effectively as a monitor. Accessories such as high filter, low filter and loudness control are mounted."

name: B-2103ΩMOSVINTAGE
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier that uses a MOS FET element and is designed to take advantage of its capabilities. Equipped with an � -X balance circuit that provides a consistent balance operation from the source input to the speaker drive. The output stage is a push-pull type of power MOS FET, and a total of four amplifiers equipped with both + - and left and right speakers are driven under the same conditions. As a result, the amplifier circuit and ground circuit of the amplifier are completely separated, and the circuit itself shuts out the in-phase distortion caused by the back electromotive current and external noise generated in the speaker in principle. In addition, the NFB adopts a unique balance feedback configuration that crosses from the + side output to the - side input and from the - side output to the + side input to achieve a wide range. A power MOS FET, 2ΩSK405Ω/2ΩSJ115Ωpair is used as the output element of the power stage. This element has excellent linearity and enables stable high-speed amplification because no accumulation effect occurs.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, the MOS FET has high quietness at a minute level, low distortion factor, low impedance, advanced � -X balance circuit, and power supply section to bring out the original sound quality of the MOS FET. In order to cope with dynamic range such as digital source, cascade connection of FET is used for input, and NEW diamond differential circuit which can take out output of - side without phase inversion in power stage is adopted. In combination with the driver power supply, it demonstrates excellent linearity, large current supply capability and high-speed response, and suppresses sound loss caused by TIM distortion. In order to maximize the operation of MOS FET amplifier which requires stable large current, it is equipped with power supply of all stage independent power supply. We pursue low impedance and high speed and obtain stable current by using high performance electrolytic electrolytic capacitor and fast recovery diode as well as a vibration control structure and low leakage transformer originally developed for B-2103Ωonly.

POWER SUPPLY
In addition, a closed-loop balanced configuration is adopted in which each stage is an independent power supply and the final power supply is separated from the ground circuit to prevent sound quality degradation due to unbalanced power supply and natural vibration and noise of the power supply.

POWER SUPPLY
In order to eliminate the influence of vibration of the power supply and signal system, which is an obstacle to stereo reproduction, the power supply is placed in the center of the amplifier and the power units are arranged symmetrically using twin monaural construction. By optimizing the weight balance of the structure, the generation and transmission of vibration of the power transformer and condenser are controlled. Moreover, by realizing the shortest circuit, sound image localization and phase characteristics are improved. In order to further control the natural and external vibrations of the amplifier, an integrated mechanical feedback system is introduced. For example, a MOS FET is sandwiched between pure copper plates, and pure copper is used for transformers, bottom plates, insulators, and other parts. In addition, a Teflon sheet is used to isolate between the bottom plate and the insulator to cut off the transmission of vibration and maintain the purity of the music signal. Parts that determine sound quality are gold-plated, non-magnetic, low-impedance, high-speed, and vibration-proof. The connectors include RCA gold plated terminals made by WBT, Germany, which have low impedance and excellent corrosion resistance, as well as gold plated balance input terminals made by Neutrik, gold plated resistance (RMG), gold plated film capacitors (GUG), OFC lead butyl capacitors, and silmic electrolytic capacitors (ARSA). For the front panel, which is the face of the amplifier, a 6Ωmm thick aluminum plate is embossed in consideration of vibration resistance. In addition, the side panel with 8Ωmm thick felt inside, which absorbs unwanted reflected sound, and the chassis with the top plate made of aluminum provide a stable structure. The bottom plate is a double bottom made of pure copper and copper-plated chassis, and a newly developed oval pure copper solid insulator made of teflon sheet and felt is installed. While utilizing the internal loss of pure copper, it disperses vibration and resonance and completely eliminates internal interference and external vibration."

To realize a true balance amplifier, the B-2302ΩVINTAGE uses an � -X balance circuit composed of three components : a balance output stage, a NEW diamond differential circuit, and a balance power supply. The balanced output stage drives the speakers equally from both the hot and cold sides. As a result, there is no fundamental degradation of sound quality caused by grounding, and the distortion caused by the back electromotive force of the speakers is eliminated, enabling a powerful and accurate speaker drive. In the case of a general BTL connected amplifier, there is a possibility that the symmetry of the output signal will be lost due to the characteristic difference because the two amplifiers are operated independently. However, the � -X balanced circuit does not have this problem. The NFB nfB has a unique balance feedback configuration. It is cross-fed from the hot-side output to the cold-side input and from the cold-side output to the hot-side input. Thus, the NFB of the two amplifiers on the hot-side and the cold-side affect each other to improve the characteristics, resulting in a balanced output stage that works as one amplifier. The NM-LAPT (Non-Magnetic Linear Amplification Power Transistor), a bipolar transistor for audio, is used for the output stage. The B-2302ΩVINTAGE is equipped with a custom-developed Pc200ΩW transistor suitable for high power amplification. This NM-LAPT has a multi-emitter structure to increase the current capacity and to narrow the base width. T(cutoff frequency) has been improved to ensure linear input / output characteristics up to the ultra-high frequency range. In addition, nickel plating, which poses a problem in sound quality, is eliminated from the chip surface, and the lead is made of non-magnetic pure copper material to eliminate harmful magnetic distortion. By the way, f of a general power transistor is eliminated. TThe NM-LAPT is approximately three times as high as 60ΩMHz, while the is 5Ωto 20ΩMHz.

The output stage is a balanced drive and 4Ω-parallel push-pull configuration using 8ΩNM-LAPTs per channel to improve sound resolution and sense of localization. NEW diamond differential circuit is adopted from the first stage to the driver stage. A general balance amplifier is often equipped with a phase inverting amplifier to input a negative phase signal on the cold side in addition to the positive phase signal on the hot side. However, the NEW diamond differential circuit has a circuit configuration that does not require an inverting amplifier. The hot-side and cold-side signals are directly input to both ends of the first stage differential amplifier with two inputs and two outputs, respectively, and are balanced and transmitted to the diamond differential circuit of the pre-driver stage. The diamond differential circuit has a balanced double-end output of two sets of four outputs and drives the output stage in a balanced push-pull drive. In addition, in consideration of characteristics, four low-noise FETs with excellent linearity are used for the first stage and differential amplifier, and cascade connection is made by combining two low-noise FETs each with source grounding and gate grounding. As a result, high-frequency characteristics are greatly improved and stability against fluctuations in external impedance is further enhanced. In addition, the pre-driver stage / diamond differential circuit boasts an instantaneous large current and high-speed response with a slew rate of ¥350ΩV / Ï‰ s, and does not generate TIM (transient intermodulation) distortion that occurs when the circuit cannot follow a large input signal with a fast rise time.
